items.title: 日本上次升2碼是37年前！日銀為何這次不願一次下重手？
items.title_en: The BOJ’s Last Two‑Point Rate Hike Was 37 Years Ago – Why It Won’t Take a Big Step This Time
paras: 日銀(日本央行/BOJ)將於9月17日至18日召開決策會議，市場普遍預期將升息1碼(25個基點)，把政策利率從1%調高至1.25%。儘管部分投資人猜測日銀可能一次升息2碼，但知情人士透露，央行幾乎沒有意願採取如此激進的行動，反而傾向「小步快走」，避免為壓制眼前通膨而引爆更大的市場震盪。
日本上一次將主要政策利率一次調高2碼是在1989年，當時正值資產泡沫頂峰，甚至盛傳皇居土地價值超過整個加州房地產總值。泡沫隨後破裂，日本經濟也陷入「失落的十年」。時隔37年，儘管中東衝突、就業市場吃緊及日元疲弱推升進口成本，但目前物價壓力遠不及1980年代。
知情人士表示，如果日銀本月決定升息，最可能採取傳統的1碼幅度，以免衝擊已習慣數十年近零借貸成本的企業、家庭與金融市場，也讓央行有時間觀察過去升息的累積影響。

拒絕一次升2碼 日銀擬改採每季升息

日銀自2024年啟動本輪緊縮循環以來，每次均升息1碼，頻率約為每年兩次。過去決策官員強調，日本經濟歷經近30年通縮，因此貨幣政策正常化必須謹慎；但近來日元大幅貶值加劇物價壓力，促使央行提高警戒。
知情人士指出，日銀正考慮把升息速度加快至約每季一次。換言之，央行可能放棄單次大幅升息，改以更頻繁的小幅調整控制通膨，同時保留後續政策空間。
前日銀官員、現任樂天證券經濟研究所首席經濟學家Nobuyasu Atago表示，一次升息2碼可能被市場解讀為日銀陷入絕望，反而強化央行已落後通膨情勢的疑慮。他預測，日銀本月將升息至1.25%，並於12月或明年1月再升1碼。
日銀審議委員高田創的鷹派言論一度引發大幅升息揣測，但總裁植田和男上周表示，經濟與物價走勢大致符合預測，暗示通膨風險尚未升高到需要採取非常規幅度的程度。植田強調，只要金融環境仍然寬鬆，日銀希望繼續升息，但迄今已調高利率5次，必須審慎評估對經濟的累積影響。

日元升值緩解壓力 中性利率成決策難題

日元兌美元近期升至約153日元的7個月高點，較7月觸及的約164日元、40年低點明顯反彈，也降低日銀透過大幅升息支撐匯率的必要性。多名知情人士指出，近期數據並未顯示通膨急遽加速，既然今年仍有再升息兩次的空間，沒有必要一次用掉2碼。
日本生產者物價近期上升，可能在未來數月推高消費者通膨，但目前幾乎沒有物價與工資失控螺旋上升的跡象。金融環境也仍屬寬鬆，8月銀行放款較去年同期增加5.4%。
不過，隨政策利率逐漸接近日銀估計約1.1%至2.5%的中性利率區間，9人決策委員會中的鴿派成員可能更加謹慎。6月唯一反對升息至1%的審議委員淺田統一郎曾表示，希望看到由需求推動的通膨後才支持升息；另一名鴿派委員佐藤綾乃則主張，央行除物價上行風險外，也必須關注經濟成長下行風險。
野村證券(NMR-US)執行利率策略師Mari Iwashita表示，部分決策委員可能認為市場對升息前景過於積極，預料日銀短期內仍將堅持每次升息1碼。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will hold its policy‑making meeting on September 17‑18, and the market broadly expects a 25‑basis‑point (one‑point) rate increase, lifting the policy rate from 1.00% to 1.25%. Although some investors speculate the BOJ could raise rates by two points in one go, sources say the central bank has little appetite for such a aggressive move and prefers a “small‑step, fast‑walk” approach to avoid triggering larger market turbulence while trying to curb current inflation.

The last time Japan raised its main policy rate by two points in a single move was in 1989, at the height of the asset‑price bubble, when rumors even claimed the Imperial Palace’s land was worth more than all of California’s real‑estate combined. The bubble burst soon after, plunging the Japanese economy into the “lost decade.” Thirty‑seven years later, despite Middle‑East conflicts, a tightening labor market and a weak yen pushing up import costs, price pressures are far below those of the 1980s.

Sources say that if the BOJ decides to hike rates this month, the most likely move will be the traditional one‑point increase, to avoid shocking corporations, households and financial markets that have grown accustomed to near‑zero borrowing costs for decades, and to give the central bank time to assess the cumulative impact of previous hikes.

Rejecting a Two‑Point Hike, the BOJ Plans Quarterly Increases
Since starting this tightening cycle in 2024, the BOJ has raised rates by one point each time, roughly twice a year. Former policymakers have stressed that Japan has endured nearly 30 years of deflation, so normalising monetary policy must be done cautiously; however, the recent sharp depreciation of the yen has intensified price pressures, prompting the central bank to raise its alert level.

Insiders note the BOJ is considering speeding up the pace of hikes to about once per quarter. In other words, the bank may abandon large, one‑off moves in favour of more frequent, modest adjustments to control inflation while preserving policy space for later.

Former BOJ official and current chief economist at Rakuten Securities, Nobuyasu Atago, said a two‑point hike could be read by the market as a sign that the BOJ is desperate, reinforcing doubts that the central bank is already lagging behind inflation. He predicts the BOJ will raise rates to 1.25% this month and then add another point in December or January of next year.

Hawkish comments from policy‑review member Takada Sou once sparked speculation of a big hike, but Governor Ueda Kazuo said last week that the economy and price trends are broadly in line with expectations, suggesting inflation risks have not risen enough to warrant an unconventional jump. Ueda stressed that as long as the financial environment remains accommodative, the BOJ wants to keep raising rates, but having already lifted rates five times, it must carefully weigh the cumulative impact on the economy.

A stronger yen eases pressure; neutral‑rate estimates complicate decisions
The yen has recently risen to about ¥153 per dollar, a seven‑month high, rebounding from the roughly ¥164 level – a 40‑year low – seen in July, which reduces the need for the BOJ to use a large hike to support the exchange rate. Several sources say recent data do not show a sudden acceleration in inflation, and since there is still room for two more hikes this year, there is no need to use up two points at once.

Japan’s producer‑price index has risen recently and could push consumer inflation higher in the coming months, but there is currently little sign of a wage‑price spiral getting out of control. The financial environment remains accommodative, with bank lending in August up 5.4% year‑on‑year.

However, as the policy rate approaches the BOJ’s estimated neutral‑rate range of roughly 1.1%‑2.5%, the dovish members of the nine‑person policy board may become more cautious. The only member who voted against a hike to 1% in June, Asada Toshikazu, said he wants to see demand‑driven inflation before supporting a hike; another dovish member, Sato Ayano, argued that beyond price‑rise risks, the bank must also watch for downside risks to economic growth.

Nomura Securities (NMR‑US) rate‑strategy analyst Mari Iwashita said some policy members may think the market is overly optimistic about the outlook for hikes, and she expects the BOJ to continue sticking to one‑point increases in the short term.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉晶片股大漲力抗油價衝擊！主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股主要指數周二(8日)開盤漲跌互見，中東衝突升溫推動油價攀至7月下旬以來最高，加上美加貿易緊張，使市場擔憂能源成本將加劇通膨並迫使聯準會(Fed)升息，道瓊工業指數一度重挫約500點。
不過，半導體股連續第四個交易日走強，高通(QCOM-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)簽訂跨越多代產品的資料中心晶片合作後大漲5.5%，英特爾(INTC-US)也勁揚6%，抵銷部分風險情緒，投資人則靜待本周稍晚公布的關鍵通膨數據。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近460點或近0.9%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近50點或近0.2%，標普 500 指數跌近0.2%，費城半導體指數漲近1.9%。台積電 ADR 漲近2.2%。
國際油價逼近每桶100美元，重新點燃市場對通膨升溫及全球央行進一步緊縮政策的擔憂，美股主要指數期貨周二走低。標普500指數期貨在連假後首個交易日盤前下跌0.2%，亞洲股市同步走弱，歐洲Stoxx 600指數則大致持平。
沙國表示，該國南部石油設施遭到攻擊後已暫停運作，加上中國買盤強勁，進一步加劇原油市場供應吃緊。布蘭特原油一度突破每桶98美元，逐步逼近100美元關卡，也強化市場對各國央行必須透過升息抑制通膨的預期。
市場同時擔憂中東局勢可能進一步動盪。本周焦點將轉向周五(11日)公布的美國消費者物價指數(CPI)，這項數據可能成為聯準會(Fed)本月決定升息或按兵不動的關鍵依據。相較之下，市場已大致反映歐洲央行(ECB)及日本央行(BOJ)9月升息的可能性。
Partners Group策略師Anastasia Amoroso表示，全球央行政策正經歷相當重大的調整，市場可能進入消化階段，先前漲幅或將部分回吐，至少短期內可能維持盤整。
匯市方面，美元指數變動不大。受到BOJ可能採取更緊縮政策的預期支撐，日元兌美元一度升破153日元關卡，隨後收斂部分漲幅。
美國公債價格大致持平，投資人等待財政部標售580億美元3年期公債，隨後本周還將陸續標售10年期及30年期公債。由於長天期美債殖利率徘徊在多年高點附近，市場將密切觀察需求表現。英國最新一次公債標售的借貸成本則升至至少1998年以來最高。
Jefferies International策略師Mohit Kumar指出，債券市場部位已相當極端，殖利率短期內可能回落，周五通膨數據或下周Fed決策都可能成為轉折點。若CPI如該機構預期般溫和，空頭回補可望帶動債市上漲，而利率回落也將支撐股票等風險性資產。
除油價外，銅價連續第二個交易日改寫歷史新高，也增添商品帶來的通膨壓力。近期供應受限，加上市場預期美國可能對精煉銅進口加徵關稅，共同推高銅價。
個股方面，晶片股盤前表現相對突出。匯豐控股(HSBC-US)策略師Willem Sells認為，美股估值仍未完全反映AI帶來的生產力與獲利成長，尤其投資人對晶片業者能否實現2027年獲利預測仍存疑。Morningstar Wealth投資經理Mark Preskett則表示，多家大型AI業者財報表現強勁，但除輝達(NVDA-US)外，市場反應仍相對平淡。

items.title: 亞馬遜豪押高通！AI晶片訂單最高達600億美元 股價應聲走揚
items.title_en: Amazon Makes Big Bet on Qualcomm! AI Chip Orders Up to $60 B, Stock Rises
paras: 高通(QCOM-US)周二(8日)宣布與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)達成AI資料中心晶片合作，雙方將跨越多個產品世代共同開發客製化晶片，協助Amazon Web Services(AWS)擴充以AI推論為主的基礎設施。這項協議被視為高通進軍資料中心市場的重要突破，激勵其股價盤前一度大漲9.7%，開盤後漲幅逾4%。
截稿前，高通(QCOM-US)盤中股價上漲4.10%，每股暫報175.66美元。
根據監管文件，高通已向亞馬遜發行認股權證，使其有權以每股161.26美元的價格買進最多2,500萬股高通股票，潛在持股價值約40億美元。認股權證將依亞馬遜對高通下單的金額分批歸屬，相關訂單總額最高可能達600億美元。
雙方並未公布合作案的其他財務條款。除AI推論晶片外，高通與亞馬遜還將共同開發高速光學連接技術，傳輸速度最高可達每秒1.6兆位元，以因應AI資料中心快速成長的頻寬需求。高通也計畫擴大使用AWS的AI服務及基礎設施執行晶片設計工作，藉此縮短產品開發周期。
高通以智慧手機與行動裝置處理器聞名，但近年積極拓展AI資料中心業務，以降低對手機市場的依賴。公司今年6月發表專為資料中心打造的Dragonfly C1000中央處理器(CPU)，主打代理型AI工作負載及節能運算，並宣布Meta Platforms(META-US)將於2028年量產後採用。
高通目標在2029會計年度創造150億美元資料中心營收，並規畫推出AI加速晶片及串聯多顆晶片的互連產品。如今繼Meta後再獲亞馬遜這家超大規模雲端業者支持，進一步提高市場對其資料中心策略的信心。Meta與亞馬遜每年投入AI基礎設施的資本支出均達數千億美元。
AI晶片市場目前由輝達(NVDA-US)主導，其繪圖處理器(GPU)擅長同時執行大量運算，廣泛用於訓練及運行AI模型。不過，隨代理型AI快速發展，負責一般運算工作的CPU也日益重要。
美國銀行(BAC-US)預測，全球CPU市場規模可能從2025年的270億美元增加逾一倍，至2030年達600億美元。英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)的資料中心CPU需求均快速成長，輝達也已推出針對代理型AI最佳化的CPU。輝達AI基礎設施主管Dion Harris先前指出，CPU正逐漸成為擴大AI及代理型工作流程的瓶頸。
paras_en: Qualcomm (QCOM-US) announced on Tuesday (the 8th) a partnership with Amazon (AMZN-US) to develop AI data‑center chips. The two will co‑develop custom chips across multiple product generations to help Amazon Web Services (AWS) expand its AI‑inference infrastructure. The deal is seen as a major breakthrough for Qualcomm’s push into the data‑center market, sending its pre‑market share up 9.7% and its opening gain to over 4%.
By the time of writing, Qualcomm’s (QCOM-US) intraday share price was up 4.10%, reporting around $175.66 per share.

According to regulatory filings, Qualcomm has issued warrants to Amazon, giving it the right to purchase up to 25 million Qualcomm shares at $161.26 each, a potential stake worth about $4 billion. The warrants will vest in tranches based on the amount Amazon orders from Qualcomm, with total order value potentially reaching $60 billion.

The companies did not disclose other financial terms. In addition to AI‑inference chips, Qualcomm and Amazon will co‑develop high‑speed optical interconnect technology capable of up to 1.6 Tbps to meet the bandwidth needs of rapidly growing AI data centers. Qualcomm also plans to expand its use of AWS AI services and infrastructure for chip design, shortening product development cycles.

Qualcomm is known for its smartphone and mobile‑device processors, but in recent years has been aggressively expanding its AI data‑center business to reduce reliance on the handset market. In June, the company unveiled the Dragonfly C1000 CPU built for data centers, targeting inference‑type AI workloads and energy‑efficient computing, and announced that Meta Platforms (META-US) will adopt it after mass production in 2028.

Qualcomm aims to generate $15 billion in data‑center revenue in fiscal 2029 and is planning to launch AI‑accelerator chips and interconnect products that link multiple chips. After securing Meta, gaining Amazon—a massive cloud provider—further bolsters market confidence in its data‑center strategy. Both Meta and Amazon spend several hundred billion dollars annually on AI infrastructure capex.

The AI chip market is currently dominated by Nvidia (NVDA-US), whose GPUs excel at parallel processing and are widely used for training and running AI models. However, as inference‑type AI grows rapidly, CPUs that handle general‑purpose computing are becoming increasingly important.

Bank of America (BAC-US) forecasts the global CPU market could more than double from $27 billion in 2025 to $60 billion by 2030. Demand for data‑center CPUs from Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) is rising quickly, and Nvidia has also launched CPUs optimized for inference‑type AI. Nvidia’s AI infrastructure head Dion Harris has previously noted that CPUs are becoming a bottleneck for scaling AI and inference workloads.

items.title: 習近平同英國首相通話 稱兩國共同利益大於分歧
items.title_en: Xi Jinping and UK Prime Minister Speak, Saying Shared Interests Between the Two Nations Outweigh Differences
paras: 中國國家主席習近平8日（周二）晚應約同英國首相柏南（Andy Burnham）通話，稱兩國共同利益大於分歧，雙方應當互尊互信、超越分歧、求同存異。
據《央視》報導，習近平祝賀柏南就任英國首相，指出中英是全面戰略夥伴，雖然兩國社會制度和國情不同，但共同利益大於分歧，雙方應當互尊互信、超越分歧、求同存異，做大互利合作的蛋糕。
習近平表示，兩國政府都致力於發展經濟、改善民生，可以優勢互補、相互助力。中國「十五五」時期將進一步擴大教育、醫療、金融對外開放，這些都是兩國合作有潛力的領域。
習近平說，中英都是科技大國，都有豐富教育、文化、體育等資源，應當保持開放前瞻意識，加強各領域交流合作。
習近平稱，中英兩國是聯合國安理會常任理事國和世界主要經濟體，都支持多邊主義、開放貿易，維護聯合國核心地位，要加強在聯合國、二十國集團（G20）、世界貿易組織（WTO）等框架內的溝通和協作，推動平等有序的世界多極化、普惠包容的經濟全球化。
據《央視》報導，柏南對此表示贊同，表示英方願保持對華政策連續性，堅定不移發展英中長期穩定的戰略夥伴關係。
英方願同中方展開高層交往，推動兩國各領域合作，加強人文交流，將雙邊關係恢復到歷史最高水準。
柏南提到，在動盪複雜的國際變局下，作為安理會常任理事國，英中應推動通過對話解決國際熱點問題，共同應對氣候變化等全球性挑戰，攜手維護世界穩定繁榮。
paras_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Tuesday evening, the 8th, answered an invitation to speak with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, stating that the two countries’ shared interests outweigh their differences and that both sides should respect each other, build mutual trust, transcend disagreements and seek common ground while reserving differences.

According to CCTV, Xi congratulated Burnham on becoming UK Prime Minister and noted that China and the UK are comprehensive strategic partners. Although the two societies have different systems and national conditions, their common interests are greater than their divergences, and they should respect each other, build mutual trust, transcend disagreements, seek common ground while reserving differences, and expand the cake of mutually beneficial cooperation.

Xi said that both governments are committed to economic development and improving peoples’ livelihoods, which allows them to complement each other’s strengths and provide mutual assistance. During China’s 14th Five‑Year Plan period, the country will further open its education, healthcare and financial sectors to the outside world, areas that hold significant cooperation potential for the two sides.

Xi noted that both China and the UK are major technology powers with abundant resources in education, culture and sports, and should maintain an open, forward‑looking mindset while strengthening exchanges and cooperation across all fields.

Xi said that China and the UK, as permanent members of the UN Security Council and major world economies, both support multilateralism and open trade, uphold the UN’s core role, and should deepen communication and collaboration within frameworks such as the United Nations, the G20 and the WTO to promote an equitable, orderly, multipolar world and inclusive economic globalization.
CCTV reported that Burnham agreed, saying the UK is willing to maintain continuity in its China policy and steadfastly develop a long‑term, stable strategic partnership with China.

The UK side expressed willingness to engage in high‑level exchanges with China, promote cooperation across various sectors, strengthen people‑to‑people ties, and restore bilateral relations to their historic highest level.

Burnham added that amid a turbulent and complex international environment, as permanent members of the Security Council, the UK and China should work through dialogue to resolve hot‑spot issues, jointly tackle global challenges such as climate change, and cooperate to safeguard world stability and prosperity.

items.title: 中信銀、台壽相繼出手 合計擬砸41億元參與漢測IPO競拍
items.title_en: CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life Successively Move to Bid Up to NT$4.1 Billion in Han Test IPO
paras: 隨著 AI 產業發展，半導體設備廠漢測(7856-TW)近期IPO案掀起市場高度關注，中信金(2891-TW)旗下二大子公司相繼出手，台灣人壽日前核決授權上限20億元參與競拍，中國信託商業銀行今(8)日亦發布公告，經執行長核決通過，擬以自有資金不超過新台幣21億元參與漢測股票競拍，兩家合計投入競拍的資金上限高達 41 億元。
漢民測試系統股份有限公司為國內知名半導體設備與工程服務業者，受惠於AI應用需求強勁帶動整體半導體產業穩健成長，營運前景備受市場關注。漢測預計於9月中旬辦理首次公開發行(IPO)股票競價拍賣，吸引眾多機構法人關注。
根據中信銀行8日發布的公告指出，本次交易標的為漢測普通股，交易決策係依據內部評價及博頌會計師事務所余良元會計師出具之價格合理性意見書進行。中信銀表示，本次投資為依據銀行法相關規定，以銀行自有資金進行財務性投資，參與競拍金額上限為新台幣21億元(不含手續費等)。
在此之前，台灣人壽亦於7日代母公司中信金公告，經內部金融投資總處總處長授權，擬以自有資金上限20億元參與漢測IPO競拍。台灣人壽指出，AI需求崛起帶動半導體市場蓬勃發展，漢測等供應鏈設備廠營運可望持續受惠，因此基於保險資金之長期穩健運用進行布局。
壽險與金融業者近年積極將資金注入半導體及AI相關產業鏈，涵蓋設備服務、封裝測試、散熱等關鍵領域。由於漢測IPO目前尚未開標，中信銀與台灣人壽皆表示，實際取得之股數、每股單位價格與最終交易總金額，均須待正式開標結果確定後再行補充公告。
paras_en: As the AI industry expands, semiconductor equipment maker Han Test (7856‑TW) has drawn strong market interest for its upcoming IPO. CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) sees its two major subsidiaries act in quick succession: Taiwan Life recently approved a NT$20 billion ceiling to join the bid, and China Trust Commercial Bank announced today (the 8th) that, after CEO approval, it intends to use up to NT$21 billion of its own funds to participate, bringing the combined maximum bid amount to NT$41 billion.

Han Min Test Systems Co., Ltd. is a well‑known domestic semiconductor equipment and engineering services provider. Benefiting from robust AI‑driven demand that is bolstering overall semiconductor growth, its operating outlook is attracting market attention. Han Test plans to conduct a book‑building auction for its first‑time public offering in mid‑September, drawing interest from many institutional investors.

According to the announcement released by CTBC Bank on the 8th, the transaction target is Han Test common stock. The investment decision is based on an internal valuation and a price‑reasonableness opinion issued by auditor Yu Liang‑yuan of Boso CPA. CTBC Bank states the investment complies with banking‑law regulations and will be made with its own capital, with a bid ceiling of NT$21 billion (excluding fees).

Earlier, on the 7th, Taiwan Life, on behalf of its parent CTBC Financial, announced that, after authorization from the head of its internal financial investment department, it plans to use up to NT$20 billion of its own funds to join the Han Test IPO bid. Taiwan Life noted that the surge in AI demand is driving vigorous growth in the semiconductor market, and that equipment suppliers like Han Test are likely to continue benefiting, making this a long‑term, stable deployment of insurance capital.

Life insurers and financial firms have recently been actively channeling funds into semiconductor and AI‑related supply chains, covering key areas such as equipment services, packaging and testing, and thermal management. Because the Han Test IPO has not yet been priced, both CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life said the actual number of shares obtained, the per‑share price, and the final transaction amount will be disclosed after the formal auction results are released.

items.title: 企業砸錢導入AI卻難見成效！Google攜埃森哲派千名工程師進駐救火
items.title_en: Companies Spend Money on AI Yet Struggle to See Results! Google Teams Up with Accenture to Deploy a Thousand Engineers for Fire‑fighting
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google Cloud與埃森哲(ACN-US)宣布成立「Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group」，將培訓多達1,000名前線部署工程師(FDE)，直接進駐客戶工作場所，協助企業在Gemini Enterprise平台規畫、開發及導入代理型人工智慧(AI)應用。
新團隊除包括埃森哲FDE外，也將納入產業、流程及資料等領域的專家，負責將解決方案擴大至企業其他部門；Google Cloud則會派出小規模FDE團隊，針對少數頂級客戶提供支援。雙方表示，這項合作代表一筆重大投資，但拒絕透露具體金額。
Google Cloud執行長Thomas Kurian表示，企業需要能夠親自協助落實AI應用的專家。埃森哲執行長Julie Sweet則指出，客戶雖然理解AI的潛力，卻普遍無法將其轉化為成長、投資能力及實際獲利，因此迫切需要外部協助。
ChatGPT問世近4年後，企業導入生成式AI的投資報酬率仍不穩定，部分原因是AI工具難以整合至既有企業系統，也不容易依特定業務需求進行客製化。Kurian指出，企業還經常不清楚該如何利用AI重新設計業務流程，以及如何配合調整組織架構與人力配置。
前線部署工程師模式最早由Palantir(PLTR-US)發揚光大，核心概念是讓技術人員直接進駐客戶公司，與內部資訊科技部門及財務長等業務主管共同開發解決方案。埃森哲過去已透過一個或多個小組進駐企業，除負責實際開發的FDE，也配置產業、流程及資料專家。
若客戶希望以AI全面改造財務部門，團隊會先找出最適合導入AI的流程及執行順序。以發票處理自動化為例，團隊可在8至12周內完成流程盤點、企業資料整合及代理型AI方案建置，確保系統具備全面擴充能力，再制定推廣藍圖並交由埃森哲其他團隊擴大部署。
這項合作正值FDE市場競爭迅速升溫。AI業者投入數兆美元建設基礎設施後，面臨加快企業採用速度、證明投資價值的壓力。OpenAI今年成立獨立服務公司OpenAI Deployment Co.，Anthropic也透過Applied AI團隊提供類似服務，微軟(MSFT-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下Amazon Web Services(AWS)近期亦相繼擴大FDE計畫。
儘管外界質疑埃森哲等傳統顧問公司能否提供足夠深入的AI技術能力，Sweet認為，埃森哲長期服務大型企業的經驗正是競爭優勢，因為導入AI不只需要開發技術，更必須了解如何在規模龐大、系統複雜的企業中真正完成部署。
paras_en: Alphabet’s Google Cloud and Accenture announced the creation of the “Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group,” which will train up to 1,000 frontline deployment engineers (FDEs) who will work directly on‑site at client locations to help enterprises plan, develop and implement agency‑type AI applications on the Gemini Enterprise platform.

The new team will include not only Accenture FDEs but also experts in industry, processes and data who will expand solutions to other parts of the enterprise; Google Cloud will contribute a smaller FDE squad to support a select group of top‑tier customers. Both sides say the partnership represents a major investment, though they declined to disclose the exact amount.

Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said companies need experts who can personally help them realize AI use cases. Accenture CEO Julie Sweet added that while clients understand AI’s potential, they generally cannot translate it into growth, investment capacity or real profit, creating an urgent need for external assistance.

Nearly four years after ChatGPT’s debut, the ROI of generative‑AI investments remains uneven, partly because AI tools are hard to integrate into existing corporate systems and difficult to customize for specific business needs. Kurian noted that firms often don’t know how to redesign processes with AI or how to align organizational structures and staffing accordingly.

The frontline deployment engineer model was popularized by Palantir, whose core idea is to embed technologists inside client firms to co‑develop solutions with internal IT and finance leaders. Accenture has previously deployed one or more small squads into enterprises, providing both FDEs who do the hands‑on development and industry, process and data specialists.

If a client wants to overhaul its finance function with AI, the team first identifies the most suitable processes and rollout sequence. For example, automating invoice processing can be completed in 8‑12 weeks, covering process mapping, corporate data integration and agency‑type AI solution building, ensuring the system is fully scalable before a rollout blueprint is created and handed off to other Accenture teams for broader deployment.

The partnership comes as competition for FDE services heats up. After AI vendors poured trillions of dollars into infrastructure, they now face pressure to accelerate corporate adoption and prove investment value. This year OpenAI launched an independent service arm, OpenAI Deployment Co.; Anthropic offers similar services through its Applied AI team, and Microsoft and Amazon Web Services have recently expanded their own FDE programs.

Although some question whether traditional consulting firms like Accenture can deliver deep AI technical expertise, Sweet argues that Accenture’s long‑standing experience serving large enterprises is a competitive advantage, because AI adoption requires not only development skills but also an understanding of how to truly deploy solutions at scale in complex, massive organizations.

items.title: 歐洲天然氣飆3年新高 德國庫存創15年新低 引發冬季危機
items.title_en: European Natural Gas Hits 3-Year High, German Inventories Drop to 15-Year Low, Sparking Winter Crisis
paras: 隨著冬季臨近，歐洲天然氣價格創下3年新高，自6月下旬以來已暴漲逾80%，荷蘭基準天然氣期貨日前已升至每兆瓦時74.95歐元。
天然氣價格飆升的主要原因，在於歐洲面臨嚴重的冬季供應短缺風險。其中，歐洲最大儲氣國的德國，其地下儲氣庫容量目前僅約53%(或約半滿)，創下15年來歷史同期新低。
德國天然氣儲能協會(INES)警告，即便加速注氣，11月1日的儲氣率最高也只能達到77%；若按近期的緩慢速度持續，屆時儲氣率恐僅有63%。一旦遭遇極端寒冬，明年1月份特定日期的供應缺口恐高達25%。
令人擔憂的是，注氣進度緩慢的主因在於「夏低冬高」的季節性價差過窄，導致貿易商在扣除成本後缺乏注氣誘因，即便已預訂83%的儲氣容量，實際注氣進度依然遲緩。此外，歐洲如今高度依賴液化天然氣(LNG)，波斯灣地緣政治不確定性與荷姆茲海峽的衝突風險，更直接加劇了供應鏈的脆弱性與價格壓力。
這場能源危機同時引發了歐洲股市的劇烈分化。直接受益的能源行業今年以來大漲逾三分之一；基礎資源類股也因通膨題材上漲約30%。同時，8月歐元區通膨率攀升至3.3%，市場預期歐洲央行(ECB)即將升息，使銀行業(如匯豐、桑坦德和法國巴黎銀行)因淨利差擴大而成為第三大受益產業。
相反地，高昂的能源與資金成本正沉重打擊高耗能產業，如建築材料與化學工業；汽車巨頭則因高油價抑制大排量燃油車需求而表現低迷；航空公司也飽受燃油成本上漲之苦。
市場目前正密切關注本周的央行利率決議與地緣政治局勢，這將共同決定此波「冬季交易主線」的強度與持續時間。
paras_en: As winter approaches, European natural gas prices have surged to a three‑year high, jumping more than 80% since late June, with the Dutch benchmark gas futures recently climbing to €74.95 per megawatt‑hour.

The main driver of the price spike is the serious risk of winter supply shortages across Europe. In Germany, the continent’s largest gas‑storage holder, underground storage capacity is now only about 53% (roughly half full), a historic low for the same period in the past 15 years.

The German Gas Storage Association (INES) warned that even with accelerated injection, the storage level on November 1 can at best reach 77%; at the current slow injection pace it could be only 63%, and a severe cold snap could create a supply gap of up to 25% on specific dates in January next year.

The sluggish injection is mainly due to the very narrow “summer low, winter high” seasonal price spread, which leaves traders with little incentive to inject after costs are covered. Even though 83% of storage capacity has been booked, actual injection remains slow. Moreover, Europe’s heavy reliance on LNG, combined with geopolitical uncertainty in the Persian Gulf and conflict risk in the Hormuz Strait, further weakens the supply chain and adds price pressure.

The energy crisis has also triggered stark divergence in European equity markets. Energy stocks have rallied more than a third so far this year, while basic resources have risen about 30% on inflation themes. At the same time, Euro‑area inflation hit 3.3% in August, prompting expectations of an ECB rate hike, which makes banks such as HSBC, Santander and BNP Paribas beneficiaries as net‑interest margins expand, becoming the third‑largest winning sector.

Conversely, high energy and financing costs are hitting high‑consumption sectors hard, such as construction materials and chemicals; auto giants are lagging as high fuel prices curb demand for large‑displacement gasoline cars; and airlines are suffering from soaring fuel expenses.
Markets are now closely watching this week’s central‑bank rate decisions and geopolitical developments, which together will determine the strength and duration of this “winter‑trade theme.”

items.title: 摺疊iPhone撐起蘋果硬體光環？特納斯更難的一戰是救活Siri
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)將於美西時間周三(9日)、台灣時間周四(10日)首度主持新品發表會，市場預期首款摺疊iPhone將成為全場焦點，但華爾街更關注，他能否證明蘋果仍有打造突破性硬體的能力，並讓Siri在人工智慧(AI)競賽中追上對手。
分析師預期，蘋果將在加州庫比蒂諾總部發表一款可像護照般向內折疊的新iPhone。儘管售價可能超過2,500美元，且相機與處理器規格未必領先市場，仍有望迅速成為剛起步的摺疊手機市場領導者。
蘋果已宣布大幅改造Siri，並在背後部分採用Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google的AI技術。分析師認為，若新版Siri能在今年底前順利推出，可能成為特納斯接任後首項重大成果，也有機會縮小與Google Gemini的差距。
投資人過去大致忽略蘋果在生成式AI領域起步較慢的問題，主因其全球擁有超過10億台裝置的龐大用戶基礎，以及高度忠誠的客群。如今特納斯必須說服消費者，蘋果裝置才是使用AI的最佳入口，這將決定他能否延續前執行長庫克(Tim Cook)留下的成長動能，或繼續扮演追趕者。

摺疊iPhone售價估破2500美元 仍被看好熱賣

蘋果預料將更新高階iPhone Pro與Pro Max，但iPhone Air、標準版及平價機型可能延至明年春季才改款，藉此將市場目光集中在本周發表會真正的主角摺疊iPhone。
國際數據資訊(IDC)資深研究總監Nabila Popal表示，即使售價高達2,500美元，蘋果摺疊機仍可能供不應求，因為蘋果擅長營造獨特、奢華及稀缺感。她估計，這款產品截至明年底可為蘋果創造超過450億美元營收，即使摺疊機在整體智慧手機市場的占比仍不到10%。
在直板手機主導市場近20年後，摺疊設計本身的新鮮感將是最大賣點。三星、Google與中國華為自2019年起便已銷售摺疊手機，但分析師認為，蘋果較晚進場反而能吸取競爭對手的經驗，改善轉軸耐用度及螢幕展開後的摺痕等問題。
Moor Insights & Strategy分析師Anshel Sag表示，蘋果已經觀察到競爭對手哪些設計有效、哪些失敗，因此有機會避開現有摺疊手機的主要缺陷。

新版Siri迎關鍵考驗 中國、歐洲推出恐受阻

除了摺疊iPhone，特納斯另一項關鍵任務是說服消費者採用新版Siri，並向第三方開發者證明，蘋果有能力跟上OpenAI等競爭對手幾乎每隔幾周便推出重大更新的速度。蘋果過去偏向謹慎、緩慢推出新功能，與AI產業的快速迭代形成鮮明對比。
Creative Strategies分析師Carolina Milanesi表示，如果Siri依然表現不佳，特納斯這場發表會將難以過關；如今蘋果至少可以宣稱Siri已經具備實際價值，但仍須持續改善並跟上競爭對手。
特納斯過去5年擔任硬體工程主管期間作風低調，分析師預期，他將強調以高效能裝置作為發展裝置端AI的基礎。不過，監管障礙可能拖慢蘋果的全球布局。
Deepwater Asset Management分析師Gene Munster指出，新版Siri在中國可能要到2028年才能取得批准，歐洲市場初期也將因監管爭議無法使用。因此，蘋果能否按時在美國推出新版Siri至關重要，這將建立外界對其日後拓展歐洲市場的信心。

items.title: 中信銀、台壽相繼出手 合計擬砸41億元參與漢測IPO競拍
items.title_en: CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life Successively Move to Bid Up to NT$4.1 Billion in Han Test IPO
paras: 隨著 AI 產業發展，半導體設備廠漢測(7856-TW)近期IPO案掀起市場高度關注，中信金(2891-TW)旗下二大子公司相繼出手，台灣人壽日前核決授權上限20億元參與競拍，中國信託商業銀行今(8)日亦發布公告，經執行長核決通過，擬以自有資金不超過新台幣21億元參與漢測股票競拍，兩家合計投入競拍的資金上限高達 41 億元。
漢民測試系統股份有限公司為國內知名半導體設備與工程服務業者，受惠於AI應用需求強勁帶動整體半導體產業穩健成長，營運前景備受市場關注。漢測預計於9月中旬辦理首次公開發行(IPO)股票競價拍賣，吸引眾多機構法人關注。
根據中信銀行8日發布的公告指出，本次交易標的為漢測普通股，交易決策係依據內部評價及博頌會計師事務所余良元會計師出具之價格合理性意見書進行。中信銀表示，本次投資為依據銀行法相關規定，以銀行自有資金進行財務性投資，參與競拍金額上限為新台幣21億元(不含手續費等)。
在此之前，台灣人壽亦於7日代母公司中信金公告，經內部金融投資總處總處長授權，擬以自有資金上限20億元參與漢測IPO競拍。台灣人壽指出，AI需求崛起帶動半導體市場蓬勃發展，漢測等供應鏈設備廠營運可望持續受惠，因此基於保險資金之長期穩健運用進行布局。
壽險與金融業者近年積極將資金注入半導體及AI相關產業鏈，涵蓋設備服務、封裝測試、散熱等關鍵領域。由於漢測IPO目前尚未開標，中信銀與台灣人壽皆表示，實際取得之股數、每股單位價格與最終交易總金額，均須待正式開標結果確定後再行補充公告。
paras_en: As the AI industry expands, semiconductor equipment maker Han Test (7856‑TW) has drawn strong market interest for its upcoming IPO. CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) sees its two major subsidiaries act in quick succession: Taiwan Life recently approved a NT$20 billion ceiling to join the bid, and China Trust Commercial Bank announced today (the 8th) that, after CEO approval, it intends to use up to NT$21 billion of its own funds to participate, bringing the combined maximum bid amount to NT$41 billion.

Han Min Test Systems Co., Ltd. is a well‑known domestic semiconductor equipment and engineering services provider. Benefiting from robust AI‑driven demand that is bolstering overall semiconductor growth, its operating outlook is attracting market attention. Han Test plans to conduct a book‑building auction for its first‑time public offering in mid‑September, drawing interest from many institutional investors.

According to the announcement released by CTBC Bank on the 8th, the transaction target is Han Test common stock. The investment decision is based on an internal valuation and a price‑reasonableness opinion issued by auditor Yu Liang‑yuan of Boso CPA. CTBC Bank states the investment complies with banking‑law regulations and will be made with its own capital, with a bid ceiling of NT$21 billion (excluding fees).

Earlier, on the 7th, Taiwan Life, on behalf of its parent CTBC Financial, announced that, after authorization from the head of its internal financial investment department, it plans to use up to NT$20 billion of its own funds to join the Han Test IPO bid. Taiwan Life noted that the surge in AI demand is driving vigorous growth in the semiconductor market, and that equipment suppliers like Han Test are likely to continue benefiting, making this a long‑term, stable deployment of insurance capital.

Life insurers and financial firms have recently been actively channeling funds into semiconductor and AI‑related supply chains, covering key areas such as equipment services, packaging and testing, and thermal management. Because the Han Test IPO has not yet been priced, both CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life said the actual number of shares obtained, the per‑share price, and the final transaction amount will be disclosed after the formal auction results are released.

items.title: 主動式ETF正夯，該賣掉0050跳槽嗎？清流君回測打臉：抱超過15年，有8成落後大盤！
paras: 近期台股市場掀起一陣「主動式 ETF」旋風，各大投信紛紛推出標榜「經理人主動選股、汰弱留強、追求超額報酬」的全新商品。看著檔檔吸睛的宣傳文案與短線亮麗的走勢，許多原本堅定持有 0050 等被動市值型 ETF 的投資人，內心不禁開始動搖：
「0050 只會傻傻照市值買，遇到弱勢股也不會砍，是不是落伍了？」
「主動式 ETF 有專業研究團隊操盤，還能靈活避開下市風險，我是不是該把 0050 賣掉，跳槽轉戰主動型商品？」
對於市場上的換股焦慮，長期倡導指數化投資的達人清流君在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中斬釘截鐵地表示：「主動式 ETF 我個人是完全不碰的！因為只要時間拉長，它們的長期績效勢必會落後大盤指數。」
清流君更拿出國際機構研究與台股過去 20 年的本土資料庫回測，用冷靜的數據「打臉」市場熱潮，揭開主動式投資光鮮亮麗背後最殘酷的真相。

一、標普道瓊 SPIVA 報告曝光：短中天期已顯露敗象
很多人以為台灣股市是「散戶多、淺碟型」的市場，主動選股應該很容易打敗大盤。但國際權威機構標普道瓊指數編撰公司（S&P Dow Jones Indices）針對台灣市場長期追蹤的 SPIVA 報告，直接推翻了這個幻想：
專門針對台股大型股的主動型基金進行統計，在過去 5 到 6 年的觀察期間，落後大型指數的比例高達 60% 至 84%！
換言之，即便是由台灣頂尖投信團隊操盤的主動型基金，光是看近 5～6 年的中期成績單，就有六到八成的經理人繳出不如大盤的及格線成績。

二、回測 20 年台股資料庫：拉長到 15 年，逾 8 成打不贏 0050！
為了不讓數據受限於單一週期，清流君親自調閱 TEJ（台灣經濟新報）共同基金資料庫，進行了一場跨越 20 年（涵蓋約 370 檔台股主動基金）的終極回測。

關鍵：必須把「倖存者偏誤」加進去！
清流君特別強調，很多機構的績效統計會「美化」數據，因為他們只看目前還活著的基金。「這就像看見幾家創業成功的富豪，就斷言創業百分之百會發大財一樣荒謬！」
在這項回測中，清流君將過去十幾年間被清算、倒閉、合併、下市的台股基金通通保留在分母中，以各期期末往回推算，與 0050（含息再投入）進行對決：
持有 3 年至 10 年： 主動基金贏過 0050 的機率大約是 50% 左右（一半一半）。這也是為什麼主動式 ETF 剛推出 3～5 年時最容易吸金，因為此時看似還有一半的經理人能跑贏大盤。
拉長至 15 年、20 年： 勝率呈現雪崩式暴跌！能戰勝 0050 的主動基金只剩下 10%～20% 左右。
這項歷史鐵證告訴我們：只要抱得夠久（超過 15 年），有高達 80% 到 90% 的主動型基金都會被 0050 狠狠甩在後頭！

三、散戶最愛犯的致命大忌：「看過去排行榜挑基金」
「那我不買隨便的主動基金，我專挑過去 3 年或 5 年績效排名前 3 名、前 5 名的『神仙經理人』總可以了吧？」
針對投資人這種常見的僥倖心理，清流君引用美國經典研究方法，統計了 2007 年至 2025 年底的真實數據：
將市場上的基金依過去 3 年績效切分為：贏家組（前 10%）、中間組與輸家組（倒數 10%）。
每組以等權重配置持有 3 年（含息再投入），再拿去跟 0050 比較。
回測結果出現了極度諷刺的一幕：
贏家組依然輸給大盤： 過去 3 年績效最強的前 10% 贏家基金，雖然表現優於中間組與輸家組，但累積總績效依舊落後給 0050！
被唾棄的「輸家組」居然沒差多少： 過去被投資人罵到臭頭、績效墊底的輸家組，如果在後續持續持有，長期年化報酬竟然與贏家組非常接近。
清流君警告：看過去績效去挑主動式 ETF，是投資世界中最危險的「後見之明偏誤（Hindsight Bias）」！ 你誤以為自己找到了事前答案，但實際上你只是選中了一個「剛好在過去 3 年押對行情的幸運兒」，而市場的均值回歸很快就會讓超額報酬消失殆盡。

四、主動型 ETF 為何注定難以擊敗大盤？
為什麼主動型基金與主動式 ETF 隨著時間拉長，績效幾乎必然劣化？核心原因有三：
高昂的內扣摩擦成本： 主動型商品通常收取較高的經理費、保管費與換股周轉交易成本，經理人每年還沒開跑，就先落後大盤 1%～2% 的起跑線。
經理人的風格漂移與更換： 神級經理人可能跳槽、退休，或是其擅長的投資風格（如小型成長股）不再受市場青睞。
零和賽局的殘酷現實： 市場上的機構法人越來越多，所有頂尖大腦彼此競爭扣除手續費後，整體主動資金的平均回報在數學上必然低於市場整體指數。

五、什麼樣的人才能買主動式 ETF？
難道主動式 ETF 真的完全一無是處嗎？清流君給出明確界線：
可以買的情境： 除非你深入研究過該經理人團隊超過 10 年以上的完整操盤經歷，並且你具備堅定不移的信念，相信他在未來 10 到 20 年都能持續打破「8成落後」的統計鐵律，那你可以考慮支持。
絕對不要買的情境： 如果你是抱著**「賭一把」、「看最近很紅想賺波段短線」、「把它當個股在追高殺低」**的心態進場，那麼歷史數據證明，你大概率只會成為繳納高額管理費的韭菜。

結論：不要被行銷包裝迷惑，堅守 0050 才是致勝大道
「最好的投資方式，往往也是最無聊的方式。」
看著滿天飛舞的主動式 ETF 廣告與華麗文案，投資人切莫患了 FOMO（害怕錯過）的毛病。回測 20 年的血淋淋數據已經證明：時間是被動指數投資最好的朋友，卻是主動選股最大的敵人。
如果你手頭握著 0050 或 006208，根本不需要費盡心思換股跳槽。繼續無視市場噪音，將資金穩穩地放在市值型大盤 ETF 裡，「無腦 All-in、長期持有、捏緊捏爆」，你就能輕鬆擊敗市場上 80% 以上忙進忙出的主動選股專家！

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉「金九銀十」旺季+電子材料產能趨滿載 台塑、南亞看好Q4業績更亮眼
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics' Four-Product Business: "Golden September, Silver October" Peak Season and Near‑Full Capacity in Electronic Materials; Formosa and Nan Ya Expect Even Brighter Q4 Results
paras: 台塑(1301-TW)四寶今日自結8月營收，展望今(2026)年3、4季業績，台塑認為，中東衝突持續反覆不定，在原油期貨價格居高不下，第3季營業額低於第2季，但9月中國進入石化「金九銀十」旺季，加上開工率及產銷量提高下，估計第4季業績將高於第3季。南亞(1301-TW)則持續受惠AI硬體推陳出新，電子材料進入成長起飛期，估第3、4季業績優於第2季，未來逐季轉佳。
台塑表示，第3季因8月配合台塑化(6505-TW)OL-3歲修，9月恢復正常生產，預期產量比8月增加，雖然第3季中油及台塑化乙烯、丙烯供給量增加，本公司開工率及產銷量提高，但美伊戰爭反覆，原油價格上下震盪，客戶購料心態保守，影響石化行情，第3季營業額略低於第2季，但第3季因有現金股利11億元，以及台塑美國公司換股利益約13億元入帳，有望挹注獲利。
針對第4季旺季，台塑表示，在中東持續升溫，讓原油價格居高不下，帶動乙烯、丙烯價格上漲，也誘發下游客戶「買漲不買跌」的補庫存行情，短期石化產品價格呈現震盪偏強走勢，但若美伊衝突持續延長擴大，中東石化產品物流受阻，有利推升亞洲石化產品價格。
台塑也指出，公司在第4季開工率為75％將高於第3季65％，預期第4季營業額高於第3季。
南亞則表示，第3季電子材料營運正進入成長起飛期，是公司營收成長的主要動力，加上把握乙二醇外銷市場利差，增開產線，貢獻營收，預期9月營收較8月成長，第3季較第2季暨去(2025)年同期增加，第4季營收也有望較第3季逐季成長。
南亞強調，第3、4季產品持續因業界看好AI算力規模，於未來幾年內仍會大幅成長，讓產業鏈相關業者持續推進資本支出，且預期邊緣運算將帶動終端電子產品的升級需要，可望驅動各類電子材料產品營收成長，目前南亞電子材料各產線產能利用率已趨近滿載，除新廠擴建案以外，也積極執行短期產能提升措施。
南亞表示，在產能布局上，已針對銅箔基板廠進行製程優化，並在兩岸增設一定數量的特殊玻纖紡位，另新增的玻纖布織機也將陸續到位，上述短期措施預計可於今年第4季至明(2027)年起開始貢獻產能及營收，有利於即時掌握商機。
南亞也說，除了AI電子材料，公司在塑膠加工近年運用深厚加工技術，開發出新用途、新材質等整合性產品，近年來致力於市場拓展布局、技術紮根等，已在最近的高階產品認證看到良好成果，進程順利且數據表現優異，待放量後，對營運將會有長期貢獻。
台化(1326-TW)則表示，隨油價持續攀升，預期化工產品及塑料全部跟漲，加上夏天高溫及假期結束，預期9 月份營收會比8 月份改善，中東衝突應會持續一段時間，短時間不易解決，預期油價將維持高位震盪，第3季受原油波動及淡季影響，本業經營不如預期，但原油維持高位，權益法投資收入將有所挹注。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) reported its August revenue today and looked ahead to its performance in the third and fourth quarters of 2026. The company said that the ongoing, unpredictable Middle‑East conflict keeps crude oil futures prices high, resulting in third‑quarter sales lower than the second quarter. However, September marks China’s petrochemical "golden September, silver October" peak season, and with higher plant utilization and sales volumes, Formosa expects fourth‑quarter results to exceed those of the third quarter. Nan Ya (1301‑TW) continues to benefit from the rapid rollout of AI hardware, putting its electronic materials business into a growth‑take‑off phase, and forecasts that both Q3 and Q4 will outperform Q2, with performance improving quarter by quarter.

Formosa noted that the third quarter was affected by an August shutdown at its Formosa Chemicals (6505‑TW) OL‑3 unit for a three‑year overhaul. Production resumed to normal in September, and output is expected to rise versus August. Although ethylene and propylene supplies from CPC and Formosa Chemicals increased and the company’s plant utilization and sales volumes rose, the back‑and‑forth US‑Iran war caused crude price volatility and made customers more cautious in purchasing, dampening petrochemical market sentiment. Consequently, third‑quarter revenue was slightly lower than the second quarter, but the quarter includes a cash dividend of NT$1.1 billion and a share‑exchange gain of about NT$1.3 billion from Formosa’s U.S. subsidiary, which should boost earnings.

Regarding the fourth‑quarter peak season, Formosa said that the continued heating of the Middle East keeps crude prices elevated, driving up ethylene and propylene prices and prompting downstream customers to “buy the rise, not the fall,” restocking inventories. In the short term, petrochemical product prices are expected to remain volatile but on the stronger side. If the US‑Iran conflict persists or expands, logistics disruptions in the Middle East could further lift Asian petrochemical prices.
Formosa also pointed out that its plant utilization is projected at 75 % in Q4, up from 65 % in Q3, and it expects fourth‑quarter revenue to be higher than the third quarter.

Nan Ya said its electronic materials business is entering a growth‑take‑off period in Q3, becoming the main driver of revenue growth. By capitalizing on price differentials in the ethylene glycol export market and adding new production lines, the company contributed to higher sales and expects September revenue to grow versus August. Revenue in Q3 should exceed Q2 and also be higher than the same period in 2025, with Q4 revenue likely to grow sequentially from Q3.

Nan Ya emphasized that product demand in Q3 and Q4 will continue to rise as the industry remains optimistic about AI compute scale, which is expected to grow substantially over the next few years. This outlook encourages upstream players to increase capital spending, and edge computing is projected to drive upgrades in end‑user electronic products, boosting sales across all electronic‑material categories. Currently, utilization rates across Nan Ya’s electronic‑material lines are approaching full capacity; beyond new plant expansions, the company is actively implementing short‑term capacity‑increase measures.

Nan Ya added that, in terms of capacity layout, it has optimized processes at its copper‑foil substrate plants and added a certain number of special glass‑fiber spinning stations on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. New glass‑fiber weaving machines will also be installed gradually. These short‑term actions are expected to start contributing to capacity and revenue from Q4 of this year through 2027, helping the company capture market opportunities promptly.

Nan Ya also noted that, besides AI‑related electronic materials, the company has leveraged its deep plastic‑processing expertise in recent years to develop integrated products with new uses and new materials. It has been focusing on market expansion and technology consolidation, achieving strong results in recent high‑end product certifications. The progress is smooth and performance data are excellent; once scaled up, these initiatives are expected to provide long‑term contributions to operations.

Formosa Chemicals (1326‑TW) said that with oil prices continuing to rise, it expects all chemical and plastic products to follow suit. Combined with high summer temperatures and the end of holidays, the company anticipates September revenue to improve over August. The Middle‑East conflict is likely to persist for some time and will not be resolved quickly, keeping oil prices in a high‑level fluctuation. The third quarter was affected by oil‑price volatility and a seasonal slowdown, resulting in operating performance below expectations, but sustained high oil prices and equity‑method investment income should provide a boost.

items.title_en: Deposits and Wealth Management Drive Growth! Chang Hwa Bank Posts NT$15.5 B Profit for Jan‑Aug, Up 23.21% YoY, New High EPS NT$1.29
paras: 公股行庫獲利表現持續亮眼，彰銀(2801-TW)率先公布8月自結合併稅後純益20.75億元，年增29%，累計前8月稅後純益達155.67億元，年增23.21%，每股稅後盈餘(EPS)為1.29元。受惠存放款與財富管理業務動能強勁，利息與手續費淨收益顯著貢獻，帶動整體獲利表現亮眼。
彰銀115年8月份自結合併稅前盈餘24.24億元，合併稅後純益20.75億元，年成長率高達29.16%；累計前8月合併稅前盈餘179.46億元，年增18.65%，累計合併稅後純益155.67億元，年增23.21%，營運成長動能充沛。
彰銀近年持續深化「雙翅膀」策略，以「展翅高飛、再創新局」為主軸，推動企業金融與個人金融雙軌並進，有效多元化收益來源，大幅提升非利息收入比重，進而帶動各項核心業務與資產規模持續擴張。面對全球經濟環境變化，彰銀積極強化資產品質及風險管理，展現極佳獲利韌性。憑藉穩健財務體質、獲利成長動能及卓越永續治理，彰銀近日更獲得國際法人投資青睞，勇奪「2026外資精選台灣金融10強」殊榮。
在深化核心業務之際，彰銀亦積極拓展信託服務版圖，近期攜手統一投信，為大三億營造量身打造員工福利儲蓄信託，透過員工儲蓄與企業提撥雙軌機制，結合不同風險屬性的投資組合，協助企業完善員工福利制度，並讓員工同步累積長期財富，實現「企業留才、員工留財」的雙贏目標。
此外，彰銀持續深化永續金融、氣候風險管理及公司治理，並透過綠色授信及永續金融服務支持企業低碳轉型，相關成果近年屢獲國內外專業機構肯定，在追求營運成長的同時，也持續強化永續經營與長期競爭力。
彰銀表示，未來將持續以「雙翅膀獲利模式」強化成長動能，一方面提升利差與資金運用效益，另一方面擴大財富管理與手續費收入，並深化企業金融、海外布局、數位轉型與信託服務等多元業務，兼顧業務成長、資產品質與風險管理，持續提升獲利品質與經營韌性。
paras_en: State-owned banks continue to shine in profitability, and Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) was the first to announce its August consolidated after‑tax net profit of NT$20.75 billion, up 29% year‑over‑year. For the first eight months of the year, consolidated after‑tax net profit reached NT$155.67 billion, a 23.21% increase from a year earlier, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.29. Strong momentum from deposit taking and wealth‑management businesses boosted net interest and fee income, driving the impressive overall profit performance.

In August 2023, Chang Hwa Bank reported consolidated pre‑tax earnings of NT$24.24 billion and after‑tax net profit of NT$20.75 billion, a year‑over‑year growth of 29.16%. For the cumulative January‑August period, consolidated pre‑tax earnings totaled NT$179.46 billion, up 18.65% YoY, and consolidated after‑tax net profit was NT$155.67 billion, up 23.21%, reflecting robust operational growth momentum.

In recent years, Chang Hwa Bank has deepened its “Two‑Wing” strategy, centered on “spreading wings and creating new opportunities,” advancing both corporate and retail finance in tandem. This diversification has markedly increased the share of non‑interest income, fueling expansion of core businesses and asset scale. Facing a shifting global economic landscape, the bank is strengthening asset quality and risk management, demonstrating strong profit resilience. Backed by solid financial fundamentals, growth momentum and excellent ESG governance, Chang Hwa Bank was recently honored with the “2026 Foreign‑Investor Selected Top 10 Taiwan Financial Institutions” award.

While deepening its core operations, Chang Hwa Bank is also expanding its trust‑service footprint. It recently partnered with Uni-President Asset Management to create a tailor‑made employee‑benefit savings trust for a NT$300 million program, combining employee savings and corporate contributions with diversified risk‑profile investment portfolios. The initiative helps firms enhance employee benefit schemes while allowing staff to build long‑term wealth, achieving a win‑win of “retaining talent for the company and wealth for employees.”

Moreover, Chang Hwa Bank continues to advance sustainable finance, climate‑risk management and corporate governance, supporting corporate low‑carbon transitions through green lending and sustainable‑finance services. Its achievements have repeatedly earned recognition from domestic and international professional bodies, reinforcing sustainable operations and long‑term competitiveness alongside business growth.

The bank says it will keep strengthening growth drivers through its “Two‑Wing profit model,” boosting net interest margins and fund‑utilization efficiency on one side, while expanding wealth‑management and fee‑based income on the other. It will also deepen corporate finance, overseas expansion, digital transformation and trust services, balancing business growth, asset quality and risk management to continuously improve profit quality and operational resilience.

items.title: 台灣大林之晨：若成功完成精誠公開收購 明年營收挑戰電信一哥
items.title_en: Taiwan Dali's Lin: If the Public Tender for Jingcheng Succeeds, Next Year's Revenue Could Challenge Telecom Leader
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)三大事業成長動能延續，加上近期以公開收購方式提高精誠資訊(6214-TW)持股至少39%，總經理林之晨今(8)日指出，若後續成功完成對精誠的公開收購，明年營收有機會挑戰超越中華電信(2412-TW)。
台灣大先前於法說會上修全年獲利展望，合併利益成長上修至7到9%，其中，電信業務營業利益則上調為13至15%，合併營益率上調至10至12%，合併營收則維持先前看法。
林之晨表示，此次上調獲利獲利展望並未包含精誠的收購案，仍需看後續收購案是否通過，包括能否達成39%的門檻，以及公平會是否核准，且案子通過後，還要進行董事會改選才會併表，時間點可能落在今年底或明年。不過他也提到，若後續公開收購完成，可望挹注整體營運，營收明年有機會挑戰超越中華電信。
企業服務事業商務長朱曉幸也針對企業事業說明，指出今年企業事業營運表現超乎預期，主要動力來自AI需求，首先是AI與資安，包括基礎的AIDC與相關應用，今年也看到碳盤查與能源管理商機；第二則是AI帶動大頻寬連線需求，推升企業語音業務成長，也刺激電信本業業績。
朱曉幸進一步指出，企業事業第一季成長26%、第二季成長19%，預期第三季將維持成長20%的態勢。
林之晨表示，今年企業事業營收已成長20%，是超標達成，也進一步推升整體營收成長4%。另外，預期今年電信本業維持3%上下的成長幅度，科技事業則成長4至5%。
paras_en: Taiwan D (3045‑TW) sees continued growth momentum across its three major businesses, and after recently increasing its stake in Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW) to at least 39% through a public tender, General Manager Lin Chih‑Chen said today (the 8th) that if the tender for Jingcheng is successfully completed, next year’s revenue could have a chance to surpass Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW).

Taiwan D previously revised its full‑year profit outlook at its earnings conference, raising consolidated profit growth to 7‑9%, with telecom operating profit lifted to 13‑15%, consolidated operating margin raised to 10‑12%, while keeping its prior view on consolidated revenue.

Lin noted that the upward revision of profit outlook does not include the Jingcheng acquisition, which still depends on whether the tender clears the 39% threshold and receives antitrust approval. Even if approved, a board election would be required before consolidation, likely occurring at the end of this year or next. He added that completing the public tender could inject strength into overall operations, giving next year’s revenue a chance to overtake Chunghwa Telecom.

Enterprise Services Business Vice President Zhu Hsiao‑Hsing explained that this year’s enterprise segment performed beyond expectations, driven mainly by AI demand—firstly AI and cybersecurity, including basic AIDC and related applications, as well as emerging carbon‑footprint auditing and energy‑management opportunities; secondly, AI spurs high‑bandwidth connectivity needs, boosting enterprise voice services and stimulating the core telecom business.
Zhu further noted that the enterprise segment grew 26% in Q1 and 19% in Q2, and is expected to maintain about 20% growth in Q3.

Lin said the enterprise segment’s revenue has already grown 20% this year, exceeding targets and contributing an additional 4% to overall revenue growth. He also expects the core telecom business to grow roughly 3% this year, while the technology segment should expand 4‑5%.

items.title: 問就是正2？年化35%超狂！清流君警告：1,000萬恐暴跌只剩100萬，你真捏得住？
paras: 台股在大多頭行情的推升下屢創歷史新高，市場投資熱度沸騰。除了主動式 ETF 掀起話題，另一檔被無數股民奉為「財富密碼」的標的，正是槓桿型 ETF——元大台灣50正2（00631L）。
「既然長期看好台股持續向上，那何必只買一倍的 0050？問就是 All-in 正 2 啊！」這樣的聲音充斥各大投資論壇。統計至 8 月底，正 2 單日成交金額甚至一度衝破 61.9 億元，與 0050 旗鼓相當。
然而，正 2 真的能當作「無腦長抱、養老致富」的神器嗎？被動投資達人清流君在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中以詳實數據直言：正 2 的年化報酬率確實狂暴，但在享受甜美果實之前，你必須先問自己，能否承受「資產蒸發逾八成、1,000 萬縮水到只剩 170 萬」的滅頂試煉？

一、年化報酬率 35.89%！正 2 過去 10 年的「致富神話」
回顧過去 10 多年，正 2 的表現確實讓人瞠目結舌。
從 2014 年 10 月底成立至今年 7 月底的數據回測：
0050（原型一倍）： 年化報酬率高達 20.5%（這成績甚至超越了巴菲特的長期平均水準）。
正 2（00631L）： 年化報酬率更是狂飆至 35.89%！
如果投資人在 2014 年投入 100 萬元並持續持有正 2，這筆資產至今已翻了數倍。這段期間，正 2 不僅跑贏 0050，更是狠狠拉開了巨大的財富差距。
但清流君強調：正 2 之所以能繳出這種神級表現，是因為台股過去 10 年剛好處於「超級大牛市」的單邊強多頭格局中。 很多人只看到正 2 賺錢時的乘數效應，卻完全忽視了它內部機制的「致命暗器」。

二、每天都在「追高殺低」？正 2 的每日再平衡機制大解密
正 2 之所以具備兩倍槓桿，靠的不是經理人神奇的操盤技術，而是每天收盤時機械式的「每日再平衡（Daily Rebalancing）」。
為了讓基金每天的總曝險維持在淨值的「2 倍」，經理人必須進行以下操作：

情境 A：大盤單日上漲 10%（漲後加碼）
假設正 2 原始淨值為 100 元，2 倍曝險就是 200 元。當指數大漲 10%，總曝險增加到 220 元，此時 ETF 淨值賺了 20 元變成 120 元。
這時的槓桿比例變成：220÷120=1.83倍 (低於目標2倍)
經理人動作： 必須在市場上「機械式加碼」買進 20 元的部位，將總曝險拉到 240 元，以回復 2 倍槓桿。

情境 B：大盤單日下跌 10%（跌後減碼）
同樣的 100 元淨值、200 元曝險，當指數下跌 10%，總曝險降到 180 元，淨值賠了 20 元變成 80 元。
這時的槓桿比例變成：180÷80＝2.25倍 (超過目標 2 倍，槓桿過大)
經理人動作： 必須在當天收盤「被迫賣出減碼」20 元部位，將曝險降至 160 元，才能讓槓桿比例回到 2 倍。

兩面刃效應：趨勢盤是「正向複利」，震盪盤成「波動耗損」
清流君點出盲點：「你有沒有發現？漲後加碼、跌後減碼，換成白話文其實就是『追高殺低』！」
多頭順風時（正向複利）： 股市一路上漲，今天買、明天再漲再買，追高加碼的部位享受更大漲幅，讓報酬率遠超 2 倍。
區間盤整時（波動耗損）： 當股市今天漲、明天跌、後天又漲，正 2 就會不斷上演「高檔買進、低檔砍倉」的循環，即便大盤指數最終原地踏步，正 2 的淨值也會被這種摩擦成本「默默吃乾抹淨」。

三、歷史殘酷回測：最大跌幅 -83%，資產瞬間剩 170 萬！
「如果將來台股不再是一路不回頭的瘋牛，而是遇上漫長的盤整甚至大崩盤呢？」清流君調閱了正 2 成立前（2003 年 6 月底至 2014 年 10 月底）的歷史資料，以每日還原股價模擬出一段長達 11 年的正 2 歷史回測：
數據顯示，正 2 最終雖然仍以 11.92% 贏過 0050 的 8.67%，但代價極其慘烈：
波動度放大到 43%： 你的心跳會隨著每天動輒 5%～10% 的帳面跳動而瀕臨崩潰。
資產直接蒸發 83%： 在 2008 年金融海嘯期間，持有 0050 的人資產腰斬（-55%）；但如果你抱的是正 2，原本的 1,000 萬資產將會眼睜睜跌到只剩 170 萬元！
更殘酷的還在後頭。如果我們截取 2003 年中到 2012 年中這長達 9 年的區間，回測結果顯示：正 2 與 0050 的累積報酬率最終「完全打平」！
這意味著，你整整忍受了 9 年如坐大怒神般的心理折磨，經歷了資產狂跌 83% 的絕望，最後的獲利竟然跟躺平抱著 0050 的人一模一樣。

四、問問自己的內心：你真的「捏得住」嗎？
清流君直言，很多股民在看歷史回測線圖時，往往覺得「跌下去反正還會漲回來，我有什麼好怕的？捏緊捏爆就對了！」
但真實的人性往往不是如此：
當你的 1,000 萬在短短幾個月內縮水成 500 萬、300 萬，最後在底部只剩下 170 萬時，身邊充斥著「世界末日、經濟大蕭條、台股要崩到歸零」的恐慌言論。
絕大多數自稱能「長期投資」的人，往往就在這個最絕望的時刻繳械投降，直接把資產「砍在阿呆谷」，從此徹底畢業，再也吃不到後續多頭翻倍的利潤。

總結：正 2 到底能不能買？清流君給出關鍵解答
對於正 2，清流君並非全然否定。事實上，在時間拉長至 20 年、30 年，且整體市場長期向上的經濟規律下，正 2 戰勝原型的勝率確實較高。
但你是否適合把錢放進正 2？端看你符合哪一種條件：
千萬別碰正 2 的人：
想把正 2 當作短線波段操作工具的人。
沒有看過自己資產大幅回撤、心臟偏小顆的小資族或退休族。
只要帳面虧損 30% 就會失眠、想停損的人。
建議：回歸 0050 或 006208，雖然少賺一點，但睡得著覺才走得遠。
可以考慮正 2 的人：
距離退休還有 20～30 年以上、擁有極大現金流可持續投入的年輕投資人。
充分理解每日再平衡原理，明白「盤整會耗損、暴跌會腰斬再腰斬」的底層架構。
擁有鋼鐵般的紀律，當 1,000 萬跌到剩 100 萬時，不僅不會在阿呆谷恐慌割肉，還能嚴格遵守原則、徹底「捏緊捏爆」留在市場的人。
「投資不是比誰在順風時賺得最多，而是比誰在大風大浪中活得最久。」 面對年化 35% 的魔鬼誘惑，進場前務必先惦惦自己的斤兩——那張通往財富自由的入場券，是用心驚膽跳與極致回撤的代價換來的！

items.title: 大盤估值飆破40倍天價！現在還能進場嗎？達人：回測265個歷史週期，勝率破75%的買法竟是…
paras: 台股指數在高檔劇烈震盪，0050在分割後也強勢站回百元大關，許多投資人看著自己的帳戶未實現獲利，心情卻陷入前所未有的焦慮：
「大盤漲這麼多，現在席勒本益比（CAPE）都突破 40 倍了，是不是該先獲利了結，等崩盤拉回再買？」
「手頭上有一大筆資金，現在買等於站在歷史山頂，是不是拆成 12 個月、甚至 24 個月分批慢慢買比較安全？」
面對市場極度恐高與「居高思危」的情緒，被動指數投資達人清流君在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中語出驚人地給出答案：「理性數據告訴我們，不管是高點還是低點，他奶奶的 All-in 就對了！」
在大盤貴到令人發指的歷史天價面前，一次單筆把錢全砸進去，真的是理性的選擇嗎？清流君調出台股過去 20 多年、橫跨 265 個歷史滾動週期的硬核回測數據，揭開了完全顛覆散戶直覺的殘酷真相。

一、直覺的陷阱：席勒本益比破 40 倍，「分批買」真的比較安全？
要評估目前的台股貴不貴，國際機構最常參考的指標之一是席勒本益比（CAPE，經通膨與景氣循環調整後的本益比）。
台股歷史平均： 約落在 20～23 倍之間。
目前大盤現況： 席勒本益比已飆破 40 倍大關，位於歷史排名前 25% 以上（大於 75 百分位數）的「極端深紅高估值區間」。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
按照常理與多數理財專家的建議：「股市這麼貴，千萬不要一次追高，分批定期定額進場才能攤平風險。」
但清流君指出，這種「分批買更安全」的想法，往往只是散戶為了安撫心理焦慮的自我安慰，在數學機率與回測數據面前完全站不住腳。

二、回測 265 個歷史週期：All-in 勝率高達 76.6%！
為了檢驗「整筆投入（All-in）」與「分 12 個月分批進場」到底誰更會賺，清流君調閱了 0050 自 2003 年成立以來的真實還原股價數據，以連續滾動 12 個月為一個觀察期，進行全樣本回測：

關鍵數據一覽：


總測試區間： 涵蓋 2003 年至 2026 年，共計 265 個連續滾動 12 個月週期。
All-in 單筆投入勝出： 高達 203 個週期（勝率約 76.6%，接近八成）。
分 12 個月分批勝出： 僅有 62 個週期（勝率僅約 23.4%）。
平均超額報酬： All-in 贏的時候，平均績效足足打敗分批進場 6.63 個百分點！
若把這段歷史畫成圖表，X 軸上方代表「All-in 勝出」的紅色面積鋪天蓋地；而 X 軸下方代表「分批進場勝出」的綠色面積則是稀稀落落、寥寥無幾。
(圖片來源:清流君提供)
這代表在絕大多數情況下，只要你手頭有一筆錢卻選擇分批進場，你承擔的大概率不是分散風險的好處，而是「資金閒置（Cash Drag）、眼睜睜看著股市越噴越高、最後越買越貴」的實質虧損。

三、極端高點還能 All-in 嗎？「最貴時刻」進場數據曝光
這時許多人一定會反駁：「那是因為台股長期向上！但現在是 40 倍本益比的歷史天花板啊！如果今天剛好買在類似 2008 年金融海嘯前夕呢？」
清流君進一步把歷史數據按照台股大盤的「席勒本益比高低」切分為四個組別，專門檢視「當台股處於最貴、估值最高的前 25% 極端區間」時，兩者的真實表現：
數據得出了令人震驚的結論：即便在你認為「股市貴到快崩盤」的極端高估值時期，分批進場的累積報酬依然落後單筆 All-in 約 -6.63% 到 -8.0%！
甚至連用來衡量承擔每單位風險所獲得報酬的「夏普值」，分批進場在歷史高點也沒有討到任何便宜。這意味著：分批進場既沒有幫你提高勝率，也沒有真正改善你的風險回報比。

四、為什麼「等拉回再買」往往淪為割肉收場？
很多投資人自作聰明地想：「既然在高點，我先獲利了結賣掉，等它拉回 10%、20% 我再接回來，不就能賺取超額波段利潤嗎？」
清流君直言，這種策略在邏輯上是自相矛盾的：
你猜不透市場的頂點： 你以為的 40 倍是天花板，大盤可能在瘋狂資金潮下衝到 50 倍、60 倍。當你空手在場外等待拉回，股市卻一路狂奔，最後你往往會在更高的點位因為 FOMO（害怕錯過）而忍不住追高接回。
真正的崩盤來臨時，你根本不敢買： 當市場真的出現閃崩或股災時，鋪天蓋地都是「還有下一波暴跌、這次不一樣」的鬼故事，絕大多數空手等待的人只會嚇破膽，一路等到股市打底反彈翻倍了才後悔莫及，甚至將手中的股票砍在阿呆谷。

五、達人的「All-in」哲學：不是賭博，而是恪守機率
節目中，主持人好奇追問：「大家都知道你主張 All-in，但你怎麼偶爾又說自己又加碼了？你不是早就 All-in 了嗎？」
清流君笑著解釋了他心中真正的 All-in 定義：
存量資金： 原本配置好在 0050、VT、VWRA 的資產，不論大盤漲到幾點，一概「一股不賣，牢牢留在市場」，享受長期資本成長與配息再投入的複利。
增量資金： 當每個月的主動收入、演講費、車馬費或閒錢一進到帳戶，不預設立場、不等待低點，第一時間再次「全額 All-in」投入市場。

結論：克服「畏高症」，用紀律戰勝直覺
投資市場最反人性的地方就在於：最讓你感到舒適安全的作法（分批進場、空手等待拉回），在歷史勝率上往往是賠錢或少賺的保證；而最讓你感到恐懼不安的決策（在歷史天價毫無畏懼地一次買進），歷史數據卻證明它勝率高達近八成。
「長期來看，資本市場的趨勢就是永遠向上。」面對大盤天價，與其每天提心吊膽猜測明天會不會崩盤，不如相信回測 265 個週期的數學規律。
做好符合自身風險承受度的資產配置，將資金第一時間全額投入市場，然後——「捏緊、捏爆，讓時間為你賺錢！」

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉晶片股大漲力抗油價衝擊！主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股主要指數周二(8日)開盤漲跌互見，中東衝突升溫推動油價攀至7月下旬以來最高，加上美加貿易緊張，使市場擔憂能源成本將加劇通膨並迫使聯準會(Fed)升息，道瓊工業指數一度重挫約500點。
不過，半導體股連續第四個交易日走強，高通(QCOM-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)簽訂跨越多代產品的資料中心晶片合作後大漲5.5%，英特爾(INTC-US)也勁揚6%，抵銷部分風險情緒，投資人則靜待本周稍晚公布的關鍵通膨數據。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近460點或近0.9%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近50點或近0.2%，標普 500 指數跌近0.2%，費城半導體指數漲近1.9%。台積電 ADR 漲近2.2%。
國際油價逼近每桶100美元，重新點燃市場對通膨升溫及全球央行進一步緊縮政策的擔憂，美股主要指數期貨周二走低。標普500指數期貨在連假後首個交易日盤前下跌0.2%，亞洲股市同步走弱，歐洲Stoxx 600指數則大致持平。
沙國表示，該國南部石油設施遭到攻擊後已暫停運作，加上中國買盤強勁，進一步加劇原油市場供應吃緊。布蘭特原油一度突破每桶98美元，逐步逼近100美元關卡，也強化市場對各國央行必須透過升息抑制通膨的預期。
市場同時擔憂中東局勢可能進一步動盪。本周焦點將轉向周五(11日)公布的美國消費者物價指數(CPI)，這項數據可能成為聯準會(Fed)本月決定升息或按兵不動的關鍵依據。相較之下，市場已大致反映歐洲央行(ECB)及日本央行(BOJ)9月升息的可能性。
Partners Group策略師Anastasia Amoroso表示，全球央行政策正經歷相當重大的調整，市場可能進入消化階段，先前漲幅或將部分回吐，至少短期內可能維持盤整。
匯市方面，美元指數變動不大。受到BOJ可能採取更緊縮政策的預期支撐，日元兌美元一度升破153日元關卡，隨後收斂部分漲幅。
美國公債價格大致持平，投資人等待財政部標售580億美元3年期公債，隨後本周還將陸續標售10年期及30年期公債。由於長天期美債殖利率徘徊在多年高點附近，市場將密切觀察需求表現。英國最新一次公債標售的借貸成本則升至至少1998年以來最高。
Jefferies International策略師Mohit Kumar指出，債券市場部位已相當極端，殖利率短期內可能回落，周五通膨數據或下周Fed決策都可能成為轉折點。若CPI如該機構預期般溫和，空頭回補可望帶動債市上漲，而利率回落也將支撐股票等風險性資產。
除油價外，銅價連續第二個交易日改寫歷史新高，也增添商品帶來的通膨壓力。近期供應受限，加上市場預期美國可能對精煉銅進口加徵關稅，共同推高銅價。
個股方面，晶片股盤前表現相對突出。匯豐控股(HSBC-US)策略師Willem Sells認為，美股估值仍未完全反映AI帶來的生產力與獲利成長，尤其投資人對晶片業者能否實現2027年獲利預測仍存疑。Morningstar Wealth投資經理Mark Preskett則表示，多家大型AI業者財報表現強勁，但除輝達(NVDA-US)外，市場反應仍相對平淡。

items.title: 亞馬遜豪押高通！AI晶片訂單最高達600億美元 股價應聲走揚
items.title_en: Amazon Makes Big Bet on Qualcomm! AI Chip Orders Up to $60 B, Stock Rises
paras: 高通(QCOM-US)周二(8日)宣布與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)達成AI資料中心晶片合作，雙方將跨越多個產品世代共同開發客製化晶片，協助Amazon Web Services(AWS)擴充以AI推論為主的基礎設施。這項協議被視為高通進軍資料中心市場的重要突破，激勵其股價盤前一度大漲9.7%，開盤後漲幅逾4%。
截稿前，高通(QCOM-US)盤中股價上漲4.10%，每股暫報175.66美元。
根據監管文件，高通已向亞馬遜發行認股權證，使其有權以每股161.26美元的價格買進最多2,500萬股高通股票，潛在持股價值約40億美元。認股權證將依亞馬遜對高通下單的金額分批歸屬，相關訂單總額最高可能達600億美元。
雙方並未公布合作案的其他財務條款。除AI推論晶片外，高通與亞馬遜還將共同開發高速光學連接技術，傳輸速度最高可達每秒1.6兆位元，以因應AI資料中心快速成長的頻寬需求。高通也計畫擴大使用AWS的AI服務及基礎設施執行晶片設計工作，藉此縮短產品開發周期。
高通以智慧手機與行動裝置處理器聞名，但近年積極拓展AI資料中心業務，以降低對手機市場的依賴。公司今年6月發表專為資料中心打造的Dragonfly C1000中央處理器(CPU)，主打代理型AI工作負載及節能運算，並宣布Meta Platforms(META-US)將於2028年量產後採用。
高通目標在2029會計年度創造150億美元資料中心營收，並規畫推出AI加速晶片及串聯多顆晶片的互連產品。如今繼Meta後再獲亞馬遜這家超大規模雲端業者支持，進一步提高市場對其資料中心策略的信心。Meta與亞馬遜每年投入AI基礎設施的資本支出均達數千億美元。
AI晶片市場目前由輝達(NVDA-US)主導，其繪圖處理器(GPU)擅長同時執行大量運算，廣泛用於訓練及運行AI模型。不過，隨代理型AI快速發展，負責一般運算工作的CPU也日益重要。
美國銀行(BAC-US)預測，全球CPU市場規模可能從2025年的270億美元增加逾一倍，至2030年達600億美元。英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)的資料中心CPU需求均快速成長，輝達也已推出針對代理型AI最佳化的CPU。輝達AI基礎設施主管Dion Harris先前指出，CPU正逐漸成為擴大AI及代理型工作流程的瓶頸。
paras_en: Qualcomm (QCOM-US) announced on Tuesday (the 8th) a partnership with Amazon (AMZN-US) to develop AI data‑center chips. The two will co‑develop custom chips across multiple product generations to help Amazon Web Services (AWS) expand its AI‑inference infrastructure. The deal is seen as a major breakthrough for Qualcomm’s push into the data‑center market, sending its pre‑market share up 9.7% and its opening gain to over 4%.
By the time of writing, Qualcomm’s (QCOM-US) intraday share price was up 4.10%, reporting around $175.66 per share.

According to regulatory filings, Qualcomm has issued warrants to Amazon, giving it the right to purchase up to 25 million Qualcomm shares at $161.26 each, a potential stake worth about $4 billion. The warrants will vest in tranches based on the amount Amazon orders from Qualcomm, with total order value potentially reaching $60 billion.

The companies did not disclose other financial terms. In addition to AI‑inference chips, Qualcomm and Amazon will co‑develop high‑speed optical interconnect technology capable of up to 1.6 Tbps to meet the bandwidth needs of rapidly growing AI data centers. Qualcomm also plans to expand its use of AWS AI services and infrastructure for chip design, shortening product development cycles.

Qualcomm is known for its smartphone and mobile‑device processors, but in recent years has been aggressively expanding its AI data‑center business to reduce reliance on the handset market. In June, the company unveiled the Dragonfly C1000 CPU built for data centers, targeting inference‑type AI workloads and energy‑efficient computing, and announced that Meta Platforms (META-US) will adopt it after mass production in 2028.

Qualcomm aims to generate $15 billion in data‑center revenue in fiscal 2029 and is planning to launch AI‑accelerator chips and interconnect products that link multiple chips. After securing Meta, gaining Amazon—a massive cloud provider—further bolsters market confidence in its data‑center strategy. Both Meta and Amazon spend several hundred billion dollars annually on AI infrastructure capex.

The AI chip market is currently dominated by Nvidia (NVDA-US), whose GPUs excel at parallel processing and are widely used for training and running AI models. However, as inference‑type AI grows rapidly, CPUs that handle general‑purpose computing are becoming increasingly important.

Bank of America (BAC-US) forecasts the global CPU market could more than double from $27 billion in 2025 to $60 billion by 2030. Demand for data‑center CPUs from Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) is rising quickly, and Nvidia has also launched CPUs optimized for inference‑type AI. Nvidia’s AI infrastructure head Dion Harris has previously noted that CPUs are becoming a bottleneck for scaling AI and inference workloads.

items.title: 企業砸錢導入AI卻難見成效！Google攜埃森哲派千名工程師進駐救火
items.title_en: Companies Spend Money on AI Yet Struggle to See Results! Google Teams Up with Accenture to Deploy a Thousand Engineers for Fire‑fighting
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google Cloud與埃森哲(ACN-US)宣布成立「Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group」，將培訓多達1,000名前線部署工程師(FDE)，直接進駐客戶工作場所，協助企業在Gemini Enterprise平台規畫、開發及導入代理型人工智慧(AI)應用。
新團隊除包括埃森哲FDE外，也將納入產業、流程及資料等領域的專家，負責將解決方案擴大至企業其他部門；Google Cloud則會派出小規模FDE團隊，針對少數頂級客戶提供支援。雙方表示，這項合作代表一筆重大投資，但拒絕透露具體金額。
Google Cloud執行長Thomas Kurian表示，企業需要能夠親自協助落實AI應用的專家。埃森哲執行長Julie Sweet則指出，客戶雖然理解AI的潛力，卻普遍無法將其轉化為成長、投資能力及實際獲利，因此迫切需要外部協助。
ChatGPT問世近4年後，企業導入生成式AI的投資報酬率仍不穩定，部分原因是AI工具難以整合至既有企業系統，也不容易依特定業務需求進行客製化。Kurian指出，企業還經常不清楚該如何利用AI重新設計業務流程，以及如何配合調整組織架構與人力配置。
前線部署工程師模式最早由Palantir(PLTR-US)發揚光大，核心概念是讓技術人員直接進駐客戶公司，與內部資訊科技部門及財務長等業務主管共同開發解決方案。埃森哲過去已透過一個或多個小組進駐企業，除負責實際開發的FDE，也配置產業、流程及資料專家。
若客戶希望以AI全面改造財務部門，團隊會先找出最適合導入AI的流程及執行順序。以發票處理自動化為例，團隊可在8至12周內完成流程盤點、企業資料整合及代理型AI方案建置，確保系統具備全面擴充能力，再制定推廣藍圖並交由埃森哲其他團隊擴大部署。
這項合作正值FDE市場競爭迅速升溫。AI業者投入數兆美元建設基礎設施後，面臨加快企業採用速度、證明投資價值的壓力。OpenAI今年成立獨立服務公司OpenAI Deployment Co.，Anthropic也透過Applied AI團隊提供類似服務，微軟(MSFT-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下Amazon Web Services(AWS)近期亦相繼擴大FDE計畫。
儘管外界質疑埃森哲等傳統顧問公司能否提供足夠深入的AI技術能力，Sweet認為，埃森哲長期服務大型企業的經驗正是競爭優勢，因為導入AI不只需要開發技術，更必須了解如何在規模龐大、系統複雜的企業中真正完成部署。
paras_en: Alphabet’s Google Cloud and Accenture announced the creation of the “Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group,” which will train up to 1,000 frontline deployment engineers (FDEs) who will work directly on‑site at client locations to help enterprises plan, develop and implement agency‑type AI applications on the Gemini Enterprise platform.

The new team will include not only Accenture FDEs but also experts in industry, processes and data who will expand solutions to other parts of the enterprise; Google Cloud will contribute a smaller FDE squad to support a select group of top‑tier customers. Both sides say the partnership represents a major investment, though they declined to disclose the exact amount.

Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said companies need experts who can personally help them realize AI use cases. Accenture CEO Julie Sweet added that while clients understand AI’s potential, they generally cannot translate it into growth, investment capacity or real profit, creating an urgent need for external assistance.

Nearly four years after ChatGPT’s debut, the ROI of generative‑AI investments remains uneven, partly because AI tools are hard to integrate into existing corporate systems and difficult to customize for specific business needs. Kurian noted that firms often don’t know how to redesign processes with AI or how to align organizational structures and staffing accordingly.

The frontline deployment engineer model was popularized by Palantir, whose core idea is to embed technologists inside client firms to co‑develop solutions with internal IT and finance leaders. Accenture has previously deployed one or more small squads into enterprises, providing both FDEs who do the hands‑on development and industry, process and data specialists.

If a client wants to overhaul its finance function with AI, the team first identifies the most suitable processes and rollout sequence. For example, automating invoice processing can be completed in 8‑12 weeks, covering process mapping, corporate data integration and agency‑type AI solution building, ensuring the system is fully scalable before a rollout blueprint is created and handed off to other Accenture teams for broader deployment.

The partnership comes as competition for FDE services heats up. After AI vendors poured trillions of dollars into infrastructure, they now face pressure to accelerate corporate adoption and prove investment value. This year OpenAI launched an independent service arm, OpenAI Deployment Co.; Anthropic offers similar services through its Applied AI team, and Microsoft and Amazon Web Services have recently expanded their own FDE programs.

Although some question whether traditional consulting firms like Accenture can deliver deep AI technical expertise, Sweet argues that Accenture’s long‑standing experience serving large enterprises is a competitive advantage, because AI adoption requires not only development skills but also an understanding of how to truly deploy solutions at scale in complex, massive organizations.

items.title: 摺疊iPhone撐起蘋果硬體光環？特納斯更難的一戰是救活Siri
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)將於美西時間周三(9日)、台灣時間周四(10日)首度主持新品發表會，市場預期首款摺疊iPhone將成為全場焦點，但華爾街更關注，他能否證明蘋果仍有打造突破性硬體的能力，並讓Siri在人工智慧(AI)競賽中追上對手。
分析師預期，蘋果將在加州庫比蒂諾總部發表一款可像護照般向內折疊的新iPhone。儘管售價可能超過2,500美元，且相機與處理器規格未必領先市場，仍有望迅速成為剛起步的摺疊手機市場領導者。
蘋果已宣布大幅改造Siri，並在背後部分採用Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google的AI技術。分析師認為，若新版Siri能在今年底前順利推出，可能成為特納斯接任後首項重大成果，也有機會縮小與Google Gemini的差距。
投資人過去大致忽略蘋果在生成式AI領域起步較慢的問題，主因其全球擁有超過10億台裝置的龐大用戶基礎，以及高度忠誠的客群。如今特納斯必須說服消費者，蘋果裝置才是使用AI的最佳入口，這將決定他能否延續前執行長庫克(Tim Cook)留下的成長動能，或繼續扮演追趕者。

摺疊iPhone售價估破2500美元 仍被看好熱賣

蘋果預料將更新高階iPhone Pro與Pro Max，但iPhone Air、標準版及平價機型可能延至明年春季才改款，藉此將市場目光集中在本周發表會真正的主角摺疊iPhone。
國際數據資訊(IDC)資深研究總監Nabila Popal表示，即使售價高達2,500美元，蘋果摺疊機仍可能供不應求，因為蘋果擅長營造獨特、奢華及稀缺感。她估計，這款產品截至明年底可為蘋果創造超過450億美元營收，即使摺疊機在整體智慧手機市場的占比仍不到10%。
在直板手機主導市場近20年後，摺疊設計本身的新鮮感將是最大賣點。三星、Google與中國華為自2019年起便已銷售摺疊手機，但分析師認為，蘋果較晚進場反而能吸取競爭對手的經驗，改善轉軸耐用度及螢幕展開後的摺痕等問題。
Moor Insights & Strategy分析師Anshel Sag表示，蘋果已經觀察到競爭對手哪些設計有效、哪些失敗，因此有機會避開現有摺疊手機的主要缺陷。

新版Siri迎關鍵考驗 中國、歐洲推出恐受阻

除了摺疊iPhone，特納斯另一項關鍵任務是說服消費者採用新版Siri，並向第三方開發者證明，蘋果有能力跟上OpenAI等競爭對手幾乎每隔幾周便推出重大更新的速度。蘋果過去偏向謹慎、緩慢推出新功能，與AI產業的快速迭代形成鮮明對比。
Creative Strategies分析師Carolina Milanesi表示，如果Siri依然表現不佳，特納斯這場發表會將難以過關；如今蘋果至少可以宣稱Siri已經具備實際價值，但仍須持續改善並跟上競爭對手。
特納斯過去5年擔任硬體工程主管期間作風低調，分析師預期，他將強調以高效能裝置作為發展裝置端AI的基礎。不過，監管障礙可能拖慢蘋果的全球布局。
Deepwater Asset Management分析師Gene Munster指出，新版Siri在中國可能要到2028年才能取得批准，歐洲市場初期也將因監管爭議無法使用。因此，蘋果能否按時在美國推出新版Siri至關重要，這將建立外界對其日後拓展歐洲市場的信心。

items.title: 精準出手？裴洛西丈夫申報投資後數周 Bloom Energy納入標普500 股價狂飆
items.title_en: Precise Timing? Pelosi’s Husband Reports Investment, Weeks Later Bloom Energy Added to the S&P 500, Stock Soars
paras: 美國前眾議院議長裴洛西(Nancy Pelosi)申報的一筆數百萬美元投資，再度引發市場對國會議員交易的熱烈討論。
根據2026年8月21日提交的定期交易申報，裴洛西家族在固態氧化物燃料電池製造商 Bloom Energy(BE-US) 建立了高達數百萬美元的部位，而僅在數周後，標普道瓊指數公司便宣布將該公司納入標普500指數，推動其股價急速攀升。
這筆交易是由裴洛西的丈夫保羅·裴洛西(Paul Pelosi)透過其帳戶執行。申報資料顯示，該帳戶於2026年7月24日買入100萬至500萬美元的股票與等額的選擇權；隨後於7月28日，再度買入50萬至100萬美元的股票與等額選擇權。由於國會申報僅需提供金額區間，外界推估這筆交易的投資底限為300萬美元，上限則可能高達1,200萬美元。
值得注意的是，第二批交易執行的7月28日，正逢 Bloom Energy 公布優異的第二季財報。當季營收達10.7億美元，年增165.5%，大幅超越市場預期的8.27億美元；非一般公認會計原則(Non-GAAP)每股盈餘(EPS)為0.78美元，優於預期的0.41美元。
公司執行長 KR Sridhar 對分析師表示，美國所有主要的超大型雲端業者(Hyperscalers)，以及十幾家美國新興雲端公司(neoclouds)、AI實驗室和主機代管數據中心業者，均已驗證並批准其針對「AI工廠」所提供的電力解決方案。
在被宣布納入標普500指數進行9月的季度調整後，Bloom Energy 的股價進一步飆升。雖然這僅是例行的指數維護，但追蹤高達10兆美元資產的被動指數基金所帶來的「強制買盤」，為股價提供了實質的推力。
截至2026年9月8日，Bloom Energy 今年以來已累計暴漲 206.75%，單周漲幅達 26.46%，盤前交易價格來到 266.53 美元，公司市值逼近 745 億美元。
儘管此筆交易的時間點極為精準，裴洛西的辦公室發表聲明澄清，裴洛西本人並未持有任何個人股票，對該筆交易也毫不知情、未曾參與，但依據《國會議員交易法案》(STOCK Act)，配偶的交易仍必須申報在其名下。
paras_en: Former U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s disclosed multi‑million‑dollar investment has reignited heated debate over congressional trading rules.

According to a periodic transaction filing submitted on August 21, 2026, the Pelosi family built a position worth several million dollars in solid‑oxide fuel‑cell maker Bloom Energy (BE‑US), and just weeks later S&P Dow Jones announced the company’s inclusion in the S&P 500, sending its share price sharply higher.

The trades were executed through Pelosi’s husband, Paul Pelosi, via his account. The filing shows the account bought $1‑5 million of stock and an equal amount of options on July 24, 2026; then on July 28 bought another $0.5‑1 million of stock and options. Because congressional disclosures require only amount ranges, observers estimate the lower bound of the investment at $3 million and the upper bound could be as high as $12 million.

Notably, the second batch on July 28 coincided with Bloom Energy’s release of an impressive Q2 earnings report. Revenue for the quarter hit $1.07 billion, up 165.5% year‑over‑year and far above the market’s $827 million forecast; non‑GAAP EPS was $0.78 versus expectations of $0.41.

CEO KR Sridhar told analysts that all of the United States’ major hyperscalers, as well as dozens of emerging U.S. cloud providers, AI labs and colocation data‑center operators, have validated and approved the company’s power‑solution offering for “AI factories.”

After the September quarterly rebalancing that added Bloom Energy to the S&P 500, the stock surged further. While the move is a routine index maintenance, the “forced buying” from passive funds tracking the roughly $10 trillion‑sized index provided a tangible boost to the price.

As of September 8, 2026, Bloom Energy has rallied 206.75% year‑to‑date, with a 26.46% gain in the past week; pre‑market trading showed the shares at $266.53, pushing the market value close to $74.5 billion.

Although the timing of the trades appears strikingly precise, Pelosi’s office issued a statement clarifying that Nancy Pelosi does not own any personal stock, was unaware of the transaction and did not participate, but under the STOCK Act, a spouse’s trades must still be reported in his name.

items.title: Google搜尋愈改愈難用？歐盟新規逼出29年最大倒退
items.title_en: Google Search Getting Harder to Use? EU New Rules Force the Biggest Setback in 29 Years
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google周二(8日)宣布調整歐洲地區的搜尋結果，以符合歐盟反壟斷監管要求、避免遭到進一步處罰，但警告新制將降低搜尋服務品質、推高歐洲企業成本，並讓使用者更難找到所需資訊。
Google一名主管向《路透》表示，這是Google搜尋問世29年來最大幅度的服務品質倒退。歐盟主張，相關調整有助不同企業在搜尋頁面上公平競爭，但Google認為，新制實際上偏袒Expedia(EXPE-US)、Booking Holdings(BKNG-US)旗下Booking.com等價格比較網站，又稱垂直搜尋服務(VSS)，反而犧牲飯店、航空公司和餐廳等業者的曝光機會。
Google今年7月因在購物、飯店、交通與體育等搜尋結果中偏袒自家服務，違反旨在限制科技巨擘市場力量的《數位市場法》(DMA)，遭歐盟裁罰4.6億歐元(約5.34億美元)。歐盟執委會要求Google在60天內完成整改，否則可能定期處以最高相當於全球總營收5%的罰款。
調整後的搜尋結果將在頁面最上方突出顯示一家專業搜尋引擎，其後排列另外兩家、但提供較少資訊的搜尋服務。飯店、航空公司或餐廳等業者則會被放在下方的輪播區塊，並移除即時價格等重要功能，實際排名仍由Google演算法決定。
Google知識與資訊部門資深副總裁Nick Fox表示，這些改變將降低歐洲使用者的搜尋體驗，讓網路中介平台受益，卻損害在地企業利益，並移除民眾日常依賴的實用功能；歐盟以外地區的使用者則不受影響。
Google指出，先前為遵守DMA所做的調整，已使歐洲企業獲得的免費直接預訂流量減少30%，最新措施恐讓情況進一步惡化。公司對數百萬名歐洲使用者進行測試後也發現，不滿程度相當高，因為使用者經常必須重新輸入關鍵字才能找到想要的內容。
近20年來，Google累計遭歐盟處以103.8億歐元反壟斷罰款。歐盟接連重罰美國科技企業，也引發美國總統川普批評，並揚言調查歐盟「掠奪」美國企業的作法。
paras_en: Alphabet's Google announced on Tuesday the 8th that it will adjust its search results in Europe to comply with EU antitrust regulations and avoid further penalties, but warned that the new system will lower the quality of the search service, increase costs for European businesses, and make it harder for users to find the information they need.

A Google executive told Reuters that this is the biggest decline in service quality in the 29 years since Google Search was launched. The EU argues that the adjustments will help different companies compete fairly on the search page, but Google says the new rules actually favor price‑comparison sites such as Expedia (EXPE-US) and Booking.com, which is owned by Booking Holdings (BKNG-US), also known as vertical search services (VSS), to the detriment of hotels, airlines and restaurants that lose exposure.

In July this year, Google was fined €460 million (about $534 million) by the EU for favoring its own services in shopping, hotel, travel and sports search results, violating the Digital Markets Act (DMA) that aims to curb the market power of tech giants. The European Commission gave Google 60 days to remedy the issue, warning that it could face periodic fines of up to 5 % of its worldwide revenue if it does not comply.

Under the changes, the top of the search page will prominently feature one professional search engine, followed by two additional services that provide less information. Hotels, airlines and restaurants will be placed in a lower carousel section, with key features such as real‑time pricing removed, although the actual ranking will still be determined by Google’s algorithm.

Nick Fox, senior vice president of Google’s Knowledge and Information division, said the changes will degrade the search experience for European users, benefit online intermediary platforms, harm local businesses, and remove practical features that people rely on daily; users outside the EU will not be affected.

Google noted that earlier adjustments made to comply with the DMA have already cut the free direct booking traffic available to European companies by 30%, and the latest measures could worsen the situation further. After testing with millions of European users, the company found a high level of dissatisfaction, as users often have to re‑enter keywords to find what they are looking for.

In the past two decades, Google has accumulated €10.38 billion in EU antitrust fines. The EU’s string of heavy penalties on American tech firms has also drawn criticism from former U.S. President Donald Trump, who warned he would investigate the EU’s alleged “predatory” actions against American companies.

items.title: 155億美元被迫搶進！SpaceX股價要被那指買盤點火了
items.title_en: $15.5 B Forced Into the Market! SpaceX Stock Set to Ignite From Index Buying
paras: 太空探索技術公司SpaceX(SPCX-US)近期股價陷入窄幅整理，但隨那斯達克100指數(Nasdaq 100)本月進行季度再平衡，市場預期其指數權重可能大幅攀升，進而帶動約155億美元被動資金進場，成為推升股價突破盤整的重要催化劑。
SpaceX目前市值超過2兆美元，在那斯達克100指數成分股中排名第六，但指數權重僅1.25%，位居第19。市值排名與權重出現明顯落差，主要與那斯達克鮮少受到注意的權重計算規則，以及SpaceX上市後採取分批解禁安排有關。
那斯達克計算成分股權重時，會比較公司全部流通在外股數與自由流通股數的3倍，並採用兩者中較低的數值。自由流通股不包括內部人士持股及仍受閉鎖期限制的股份，因此，對SpaceX這類自由流通比例偏低的公司而言，並非全部市值都能納入權重計算。

權重估升至2.25% 被動買盤上看155億美元

不過，隨SpaceX超過10億股解除閉鎖期限制，其自由流通股占比已由首次公開募股(IPO)後不到10%，提高至接近30%，可望在下一次指數調整中取得更高權重。
那斯達克預計於周五盤後公布季度再平衡結果，並自9月21日起生效。摩根大通證券(JPMorgan Securities)策略師Min Moon團隊估計，SpaceX權重可能由1.25%升至2.25%，迫使追蹤該指數的基金及ETF淨買進約155億美元股票。
根據那斯達克統計，截至第二季末，追蹤那斯達克100指數的資產規模約達1.7兆美元，其中包括以代號QQQ廣為人知的Invesco QQQ Trust。隨更多SpaceX股票在未來一年陸續解禁，其自由流通比例及指數權重仍可能繼續上升。
River Wealth Advisors執行長Ed O’Gorman表示，在被動資金被迫買進的情況下，SpaceX股價可能受到明顯推動，市場恐怕還需要一段時間，才能真正判斷投資人對這檔股票的合理評價。
SpaceX今年6月完成備受矚目的破紀錄IPO後，股價一度劇烈震盪，但過去4周大致在133至150美元間橫向整理，接近每股135美元的發行價。由於短期內缺乏基本面催化劑，指數再平衡可能成為打破盤局的關鍵。
Interactive Brokers首席策略師Steve Sosnick指出，新解禁股東可能趁被動買盤進場時出售持股，也可能因QQQ等指數基金需求大增而推高股價，兩股力量將決定SpaceX接下來的走勢。

逾23億股等待解禁 11月才是真正考驗

那斯達克並非唯一採用自由流通市值調整權重的指數業者，負責編製標普500指數的標普道瓊指數公司(S&P Dow Jones Indices)也在部分指數中使用類似機制。兩年前波克夏海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)大砍蘋果(AAPL-US)持股後，蘋果自由流通市值隨之增加，Piper Sandler分析師當時估計，此舉可帶來約400億美元被動買盤。
SpaceX今年6月已被納入羅素1000指數(Russell 1000)，但標普500成分股必須具備至少12個月的交易紀錄，因此最快也要到2027年中才有資格獲納入。
SpaceX首批閉鎖期股份於8月到期，一度引發供給暴增、股價重挫的疑慮，但內部人士大多選擇繼續持股，預期中的賣壓並未出現。第二批股份一周後解禁，股價同樣維持穩定。
然而，10月底前還有超過10億股將解除限制，公司11月中公布第三季財報後，另有13億股可上市交易。O’Gorman認為，11月大批股份進入市場才是真正考驗，屆時SpaceX股價能否承受解禁供給，將更清楚反映市場對其估值的真實看法。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) has recently been trading in a narrow range, but with the Nasdaq 100’s quarterly rebalancing this month, the market expects its index weight to rise sharply, pulling in about $15.5 billion of passive capital and acting as a key catalyst to break the consolidation.

SpaceX’s market cap now exceeds $2 trillion, ranking sixth among Nasdaq 100 constituents, yet its index weight is only 1.25%, placing it 19th. The gap between market‑cap ranking and weight stems from Nasdaq’s little‑known weighting rules and SpaceX’s staggered lock‑up releases after its listing.

When Nasdaq calculates a component’s weight, it compares the total shares outstanding with three times the free‑float shares and uses the lower of the two. Free‑float excludes insider holdings and shares still under lock‑up, so for a company like SpaceX with a low free‑float proportion, not all of its market cap counts toward the weight.

Weight Could Rise to 2.25% – Passive Buying Worth $15.5 B

However, as more than 1 billion shares have cleared their lock‑up, SpaceX’s free‑float has risen from under 10% at IPO to close to 30%, positioning it for a higher weight in the next index adjustment.

Nasdaq expects to publish the quarterly rebalancing results after Friday’s close, effective September 21. JPMorgan Securities strategist Min Moon’s team estimates SpaceX’s weight could jump from 1.25% to 2.25%, forcing index‑tracking funds and ETFs to net‑buy roughly $15.5 billion of the stock.

Nasdaq data show that by the end of Q2, assets tracking the Nasdaq 100 total about $1.7 trillion, including the well‑known Invesco QQQ Trust (ticker QQQ). As more SpaceX shares unlock over the next year, its free‑float and index weight could keep climbing.
River Wealth Advisors CEO Ed O’Gorman says that with passive money compelled to buy, SpaceX’s price could be pushed higher, but the market will still need time to gauge the stock’s fair valuation.

After a record‑breaking IPO in June, SpaceX’s shares swung wildly, but over the past four weeks they have largely ranged between $133 and $150, near the $135 per‑share offering price. With little short‑term fundamental catalyst, the index rebalancing may be the key to breaking the deadlock.

Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick notes that newly unlocked shareholders might sell into the passive buying, while surging demand from index funds like QQQ could lift the price; the interplay of these forces will shape SpaceX’s near‑term trajectory.

More than 2.3 billion shares remain locked, with the real test coming in November. Nasdaq isn’t the only index using free‑float adjustments; S&P Dow Jones Indices also applies similar methods in some indices. Two years ago, after Berkshire Hathaway trimmed its Apple (AAPL-US) stake, Apple’s free‑float rose, and Piper Sandler estimated the move would generate about $40 billion of passive buying.
SpaceX was added to the Russell 1000 in June, but a company must have at least 12 months of trading history to qualify for the S&P 500, so the earliest it could be included is mid‑2027.

The first batch of lock‑up shares expired in August, briefly raising concerns of a supply surge and price drop, but insiders largely held onto their positions, and the anticipated selling pressure never materialized. The second batch unlocked a week later, with the stock remaining stable.

However, over 1 billion shares will still unlock before the end of October, and after SpaceX releases its Q3 results in mid‑November, another 1.3 billion shares could become tradable. O’Gorman believes the November influx will be the true test; whether the price can absorb the new supply will more clearly reflect the market’s real view of its valuation.

items.title_en: US Stocks Open After Long Holiday Facing Oil Prices and High Rates
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股結束勞動節休市後即將開盤，市場面臨油價逼近每桶100美元、美債殖利率維持高檔，以及AI科技股能否延續買盤等三項考驗。開盤前道瓊期貨下跌近400點，標普500指數期貨小跌，那斯達克100指數期貨則在平盤附近，顯示資金尚未全面撤出科技股，但產業分化可能加劇。
中東衝突升高，沙烏地阿拉伯部分能源設施遭到攻擊，加上荷姆茲海峽原油運輸仍未恢復正常，布蘭特原油漲至每桶99美元附近，西德州原油升破94美元。油價若進一步站上100美元，市場可能重新上調通膨預期，並增加聯準會9月升息的不確定性。
美國10年期公債殖利率目前約4.81%，油價與殖利率同步上升，將成為今晚美股評價的主要壓力。能源股可望相對抗跌，航空、運輸及消費股則面臨燃料與物流成本上升；高本益比科技股也可能因資金成本提高而擴大波動。
不過，道瓊期貨跌幅明顯大於那指期貨，代表市場目前較偏向產業輪動，而非全面降低股票部位。今晚關鍵是輝達(NVDA-US)、美光(MU-US)、SanDisk(SNDK-US)及台積電ADR(TSM-US)能否延續上周五強勢。如果美債殖利率升破4.8%後，AI與記憶體股仍能守住漲勢，代表資金仍願意承擔成長股評價風險；反之，半導體股若開高走低，利率壓力可能開始蓋過產業基本面。
歐洲半導體股已率先出現高檔震盪。ASM International、BE Semiconductor、英飛凌及意法半導體盤中下跌2%至4%以上。
ASML(ASML-US)則同時出現長短期兩項變數。短期焦點是川普與習近平即將舉行的會面，以及美國是否擴大對中國的半導體設備出口限制。市場估計，中國約占ASML 2027年營收17%、2028年15%，仍是未來兩年不可忽視的營收來源。
不過，ASML股價已反映相當一部分出口管制風險，川習會可能成為股價重新定價的時間點。若後續限制沒有比市場預期的更嚴格，先前壓抑股價的不確定性就機會收斂；若管制範圍擴大，市場則可能重新檢視ASML在中國的訂單與營收預期。
長期利多在於台積電(2330-TW)今日傳出計畫在2030年前後導入High-NA EUV生產先進晶片，並與ASML研究將光罩尺寸由6吋放大至12吋，以提高曝光效率並降低生產成本。台積電提出較明確的導入時程，不只驗證High-NA EUV的商業化進度，也提高ASML自2029年至2030年開始認列相關營收的能見度，讓先進製程設備需求具備更清楚的時間軸。

paras_en: US stocks are set to open after the Labor Day holiday, facing three tests: oil prices nearing $100 a barrel, U.S. Treasury yields staying high, and whether AI tech stocks can sustain buying momentum. Before the open, Dow futures fell nearly 400 points, S&P 500 futures dipped slightly, and Nasdaq 100 futures hovered near flat, indicating that money has not fully pulled out of tech but sector rotation may intensify.

The Middle East conflict has escalated, with Saudi Arabia’s energy facilities attacked and the Strait of Hormuz oil transport still disrupted. Brent crude rose to about $99 a barrel and WTI to above $94. If oil climbs above $100, inflation expectations could rise again, adding uncertainty to the Fed’s September rate hike.

The 10‑year Treasury yield is about 4.81%. Rising oil and yields will be the main pressure on U.S. equity valuations tonight. Energy stocks may hold up, while airlines, transport and consumer stocks face higher fuel and logistics costs; high P/E tech stocks may see increased volatility as financing costs rise.

However, the Dow’s larger decline compared to Nasdaq suggests the market is favoring sector rotation rather than a wholesale sell‑off. Tonight’s key question is whether Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Micron (MU‑US), SanDisk (SNDK‑US) and TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) can maintain last Friday’s strength. If Treasury yields rise above 4.8% and AI and memory stocks keep climbing, it shows investors are still willing to bear growth‑stock valuation risk; otherwise, if semiconductors open higher and fall, rate pressure may override fundamentals.
European semiconductor stocks have already begun high‑level volatility. ASM International, BE Semiconductor, Infineon and STMicroelectronics fell 2% to over 4% intraday.

ASML (ASML‑US) faces both short‑ and long‑term variables. Short‑term focus is the upcoming Trump‑Xi meeting and whether the U.S. will expand semiconductor‑equipment export restrictions to China. The market estimates China accounts for about 17% of ASML’s 2027 revenue and 15% of 2028, still a significant source for the next two years.

ASML’s stock already reflects much of the export‑control risk; the Trump‑Xi meeting could be a re‑pricing event. If subsequent restrictions are not stricter than expected, the uncertainty that has suppressed the stock may converge; if controls widen, the market may reassess ASML’s Chinese orders and revenue outlook.

Long‑term upside comes from TSMC (2330‑TW) announcing plans to introduce High‑NA EUV production around 2030, and collaborating with ASML to double mask size from 6‑inch to 12‑inch to improve exposure efficiency and cut costs. TSMC’s clearer rollout timeline not only validates High‑NA EUV commercialization but also enhances ASML’s revenue visibility from 2029‑2030, giving advanced‑process equipment demand a clearer schedule.

items.title: PS5不只拿來賣遊戲！Sony相中2,660萬台主機背後的廣告生意
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Sony以PlayStation 5切入美國免費廣告支援串流電視(FAST)市場，首波可觸及約2,660萬台PS5。這項服務短期內還不足以撼動Roku及Amazon的規模優勢，但讓Sony取得一個直接測試機會：既有遊戲玩家能否轉化為影音觀眾，進一步增加自有影視內容的廣告收入。
美國FAST市場已具備足夠大的觀眾基礎，2026年預估觀眾達1.31億人，占連網電視用戶54%。
Live TV on PS5於8月31日在美國上線，PS5用戶可免費下載，目前提供132個直播頻道及隨選內容。Sony計畫於今年稍晚加入Bravia電視支援，並進一步拓展至加拿大。
單看硬體覆蓋規模，Sony與市場龍頭仍有明顯差距。Roku Channel截至2025年底可觸及約9,110萬台Roku裝置，Amazon的Fire TV Channels則涵蓋約6,270萬台。Live TV on PS5的2,660萬台潛在裝機基礎，較接近Walmart旗下WatchFree+所涵蓋的2,740萬台Vizio裝置。
若Bravia支援範圍最多再增加1,000萬台，Sony的潛在覆蓋量可升至約3,660萬台，超過LG Channels目前約3,230萬台的規模。不過，裝機量只能代表服務可能觸及的硬體數量，不能直接視為實際用戶。部分家庭同時擁有智慧電視、串流裝置及遊戲主機，也可能造成統計重複。
因此，Sony現階段的競爭力不能只看PS5銷售規模，而要看玩家是否願意打開服務、停留觀看並持續使用。只有當觀看時間增加，Sony才能擴大可出售的廣告曝光，讓既有內容產生額外收入。
內容是Sony較容易建立差異的資源。Live TV on PS5設有Community、The Shield、Bewitched、Crunchyroll Boxed Sets及Sony One Action Hits等自有內容頻道。Sony同時掌握遊戲硬體、使用者帳號及影視內容，有助於減少對第三方串流平台的依賴。
不過，Live TV on PS5目前的132個直播頻道少於Tubi的273個及Roku Channel的388個，其中119個頻道也能在其他FAST平台觀看。Sony雖有自有內容，整體服務在上線初期仍缺乏足以吸引非PS5用戶轉換平台的內容規模。
PS5效能高於一般智慧電視與串流裝置，可讓操作更流暢，但這不必然轉化為更高使用率。消費者若已透過智慧電視、Roku、Fire TV或Tubi觀看免費影音，未必會為了影音服務改用價格更高的遊戲主機。Sony初期較可能從原有PS5用戶中增加使用時間，而不是從其他FAST平台大規模搶走觀眾。
至於Sony與TCL的電視合資關係，未來可能為Live TV帶來更多硬體入口，但現有材料還不足以確認雙方會整合FAST服務。現階段較合理的判斷是，Sony先利用PS5驗證觀看需求，再依用戶數據決定是否把服務擴大至Bravia及其他電視平台。
不過，PS5玩家可能本來就大量使用其他免費串流服務，Sony未必能創造新增觀看時間，只是讓既有觀看行為轉移到自家介面。
因此可預期的是，市場會關注的重點並不是Sony宣布支援多少裝置，而是Live TV on PS5的下載量、月活躍用戶、平均觀看時間、廣告填充率及自有內容觀看占比。這些數據才能判斷PS5究竟只是新的影音功能，還是Sony可以持續擴大的廣告收入入口。

美元兌日圓在短短一週內，已從160日圓上方一路跌向153日圓附近。偏偏就在你剛平掉空單的時候，對吧？
日圓突破干預價位

週二，USD/JPY跌向153日圓，使日圓升至2月以來最強水準。就在上週，美元兌日圓還一度突破160日圓，意味著短短幾天內，日圓已升值約4%。



此波走勢使美元兌日圓跌破日本與美國在7月聯手干預後所觸及的價位。



日本當局在7月30日至8月26日期間動用創紀錄的15.4兆日圓（965億美元）支撐日圓。這一次，推動日圓走強的主要力量則來自貨幣政策預期。



交易員正在回補先前累積的日圓空頭部位。當時日本利率明顯低於其他已開發市場，因此交易員大量放空日圓。這些部位通常用於套利交易：以低利率借入日圓，再購買其他市場中殖利率較高的資產。


日本央行升息更近一步

日本將第二季經濟成長率上修至年化1.4%，主要受到企業投資強於預期的支撐。



7月實質薪資年增2.4%，創2021年5月以來最大增幅，並連續第七個月成長。購買力提升，讓日本經濟有更大的空間承受較高的借貸成本。



目前掉期市場顯示，日本央行於9月18日將政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%的機率約為98%。市場也已完全反映1月前進一步升息至1.5%的預期。



財務大臣片山皐月表示，在罕見的聯合干預行動後，東京與華盛頓仍保持一致，致力於推動匯率市場維持穩定。


CPI可能打斷日圓漲勢

美元方面的情況仍然複雜。8月非農就業人數增加162,000人，接近市場預期的三倍，使聯準會下週升息的機率升至約60%。



通常而言，美國利率上升會擴大美元資產的殖利率優勢，進而支撐美元兌日圓。



然而，美元指數週二跌至約98.80的兩週低點。財政疑慮以及美國通膨數據公布前的謹慎情緒正在限制美元的反應。


現在該關注什麼

美國生產者物價指數（PPI）將於週四公布，接著週五公布消費者物價指數（CPI）。若數據偏高，可能推高美國國債殖利率，甚至在日本央行出手前就引發美元強勁反彈。
從圖表來看，153日圓是眼前的重要樞紐位，接下來則是152日圓，以及具有心理意義的150日圓關卡。阻力位則位於前次干預後形成的約155日圓附近。
若價格持續跌破該區域，將確認趨勢已經轉變；但若美國CPI數據偏高，也可能提醒日圓多頭，目前正有兩家央行爭相扮演「鷹派」角色。

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金匯入動能偏強 收31.535元升值1.7分
items.title_en: NTD Capital Inflows Remain Strong, Closing at 31.535, Up 1.7 Cents
